title: Programming in Python
description:
In this course, you will be introduced to foundational programming skills with basic Python Syntax. You’ll learn how to use code to solve problems. You’ll dive deep into the Python ecosystem and learn popular modules, libraries and tools for Python. 
You’ll also get hands-on with objects, classes and methods in Python, and utilize variables, data types, control flow and loops, functions and data structures. You’ll learn how to recognize and handle errors and you’ll write unit tests for your Python code and practice test-driven development.
By the end of this course, you will be able to:
•	Prepare your computer system for Python programming
•	Show understanding of Python syntax and how to control the flow of code
•	Demonstrate knowledge of how to handle errors and exceptions
•	Explain object-oriented programming and the major concepts associated with it
•	Explain the importance of testing in Python, and when to apply particular methods
This is a beginner course for learners who would like to prepare themselves for a career in back-end development or database engineering. To succeed in this course, you do not need prior web development experience, only basic internet navigation skills and an eagerness to get started with coding.

This advanced Excel course is designed for business professionals, data analysts, and financial analysts seeking to master complex spreadsheet software for data-driven decision-making. title: Reunited Worlds [Hindi]
description: Sung Hae Sung (Yeo Jin Goo, Circle: Two Worlds Connected) is a cheery high school student. Being the eldest sibling, he wants to provide for his family instead of going to college. On the day of his 19th birthday, he gets into a car accident and passes out. He wakes up on the top of his school building. He thinks he survived and everything is normal. Except everyone thinks he died 12 years ago, and he hasn't aged at all. Jung Jung Won (Lee Yeon Hee, The Package) is Hae Sung's best friend. She was the one who took him to the place where he had his accident. Distraught, she has been unable to move on from the incident since. Having failed to pursue her dreams under the stress, she works as a kitchen assistant at a nice restaurant. Cha Min Joon (Ahn Jae Hyun, Cinderella and Four Knights) is the owner of the restaurant where Jung Won works. He has feelings for her. However, she has never shown any interest in him. In her mind, she can't be with anyone while carrying Hae Sung in her memories. One night, Jung Won finds a young man passed out in front of her house. He is Hae Sung, her first love. She is now 31; he is 19. Can they pick up their love where they left off, or will their reunited worlds always stay separate? Also known as "Into the World Again" and "Into the New World," Reunited Worlds is directed by Baek Soo Chan and written by Lee Hee Myung, the creative team behind Beautiful Gong Shim and Sensory Couple.

title: Not Your Family Man
description: Micro Drama

title: The Haunted Honeymoon
description: On their honeymoon in a remote cottage, newlyweds Amey and Radhika find themselves stalked by Malti , a beautiful, bloodthirsty spirit who wants one thing: possess Amey forever. Tension, gore and dark romance collide in this gripping horror saga.

title: King in Disguise
description: After a decade of risking his life to save others, billionaire heir Ved returns home only to be mistaken for a beggar. Humiliated, beaten, and forced to kneel by a greedy influencer and her ruthless brother—who are plotting to seize his family's empire—Ved silently endures everything to protect his sister. But when his true identity is revealed, their world is about to collapse.

title: Final Breakup
description: Ashish, a billionaire's son living undercover, discovers his girlfriend Richa has been using him as a substitute for her ex, Jay. Silently enduring her betrayal and humiliation, he walks away. Two years later, their paths collide at a conference — where Jay is fired, Richa publicly confesses her love, and Naina, who always believed in Ashish, stands by his side. A story of love lost, dignity reclaimed, and the cost of taking someone for granted.

title: Payback for Parivaar
description: The story revolves around Hardik, a man wrongfully accused of a crime against his own family. After spending years in jail, he returns with only one goal - to prove his innocence and expose the real culprit hiding within his family. Supported by Radhika, he begins a powerful journey of revenge, truth, and redemption. Watch now!

title: Adha Pyar
description: Chandni enters Somesh’s life pretending love but secretly plots with Rajiv to seize his empire. Through manipulation, murder, and betrayal, she destroys his family and leaves him broken. Surviving against all odds, Somesh uncovers their crimes, outsmarts them, and turns the game around. As greed and deceit consume Chandni and Rajiv, Somesh rises from “andha pyaar” to calculated revenge, ultimately reclaiming justice, family, and love.

title: Delivery King
description: A humble delivery man is mocked by everyone, but behind his ordinary appearance lies a business genius with unimaginable wealth and influence. As he repeatedly saves a powerful CEO from financial ruin, shocking secrets about his true identity leave his enemies stunned and his allies questioning everything.

title: Ikka Number Paanch
description: Young guy, who is a master of card games, reunites with his family who had discarded him years ago - and goes on to save them and their casino. There are multiple games involving card tricks, gambling themes where stakes are the highest - and our hero overcomes obstacles and wins them one by one.

title: Khamosh Dil
description: A passionate journalist, Akshat, loses his voice in an accident caused by his ambitious wife Twinkle, who soon begins to resent and humiliate him. As their marriage crumbles, Akshat rebuilds himself with the help of his childhood friend Reena, creating a revolutionary voice device. Rising from silence to success, he exposes betrayal, reclaims dignity, and finds his true voice.

title: He comes from the mountains  [Hindi]
description: .He comes from the mountains

title: Million Dollar Mother [Hindi]
description: The Mother Crown is a powerful family drama about love, sacrifice, and betrayal. Sangeeta, who raised three sons into a world-renowned doctor, businessman, and writer, finds her motherhood questioned when strangers claim she kidnapped them 25 years ago. As her sons turn against her, shocking truths and hidden powers surface—revealing that their entire success may not be their own, but the result of a mother’s secret crown.

title: Raja Sahab Returns
description: Surya, a former jailer and the secret kingpin of the coal mining empire, hides his true identity to give his son Adarsh a normal life. But when Adarsh is brutally humiliated, tortured, & kidnapped by the arrogant son of Surya’s own former ally, Surya is forced to step back into the world he left behind. As enemies try to destroy him and take over his empire, Surya returns as Raja Sahab,  not just to reclaim his throne, but to protect his son, destroy his enemies, & clean his empire from within.

title: Unworthy Love
description: Separated from his wealthy family after a childhood accident and raised in poverty, Navneet lives as a humble junk dealer while secretly rising to become a mysterious billionaire CEO. While hiding his elite identity to test the character of those around him, he must protect his long-lost mother and daughter from the greed and humiliation of arrogant socialites.

title: Autowala Billionaire
description: A billionaire couple goes undercover as poor to test their son’s character, only to watch him lose his values, fall for a toxic heiress, betray them — and eventually face a shocking truth that shatters every relationship. Watch now.

title: Jamai on EMI [Hindi]
description: Betrayed on her engagement day, Maira Ramani impulsively fakes a relationship with Naksh, the charming hotel owner with secrets of his own. What begins as a deal to save face and secure family inheritances soon spirals into a complicated web of emotions, lies, and unexpected love. Will their fake marriage turn into something real?

title: Bulletproof Ishq
description:
A feared builder RD's life is saved by an innocent girl, Heer sparking a bond that turns dangerously intimate.
 As she uncovers his son’s betrayal, she becomes the target of brutal humiliation and cruelty. When she hits rock bottom, the man she saved rises as her protector, exposing a truth that shatters his own family.  In the end, love survives but only after betrayal, blood, and a legacy destroyed from within.

title: Bade Miyaan Deewane
description: In a famine-stricken kingdom of Bhopal, on the brink of war in 1981, a starving old man Bundu Khan discovers a mysterious spirit that grants his deepest wishes. To escape being sent to die in battle, he impulsively marries three cousin sisters and promises them safety. But as Bundu grows younger and stronger with every act of love and compassion, enemies, betrayal, and war close in—testing whether this unlikely family can survive together. Watch Now!

title: Arranged to Love
description: A billionaire businessman, Vikram Singhania, has to enter into an arranged marriage with Dr. Bhoomi Arora because of family pressure. What starts as a cold, forced marriage slowly transforms into an unexpected journey of trust, passion, and love. Arranged to Love is a romantic drama where duty collides with desire, and two strangers must decide if their hearts can truly meet.

title: Lady Boss Returns
description:
My Boss Lady is a modern romantic drama set against the glittering world of luxury hotels, real estate empires, and high-stakes corporate alliances.
 It explores love, betrayal, and revenge through the journey of Kiara Bhansali, a self-made billionaire who hides her identity to test loyalty and integrity — and ends up meeting Tej Jaisingh, an ambitious CEO caught between love and legacy.
Their accidental meeting spirals into a whirlwind of mistaken identities, class clashes, fake marriages, and boardroom battles — until Kiara’s true power as the “Sky Queen” turns the game upside down.
 The series balances romantic comedy, emotional redemption, and corporate intrigue, delivering a story about a woman reclaiming love and respect on her own terms.

title: Pyar Dhoka or Promotion
description:
In the glamorous yet cutthroat world of corporate power, secrets are the ultimate currency. Simran and Purab, two high-profile executives, are bound by a marriage they keep hidden from the very empire they run thanks to strict company policies. But behind closed doors, their relationship is on the verge of collapse.

Enter Veer and Tanya, ambitious new interns who quickly realize that charm can be just as powerful as talent.

title: We, the Emperor
description: Watch "We, the Emperor" Only On KUKKU TV!

title: God Of Cricket
description: A Janitor is a hidden fireball bowler who saves a cricket team from losing the Delhi premiere league.

title: The Undercover Lady CEO
description: When TerraGem’s young VP Alisha Talwar goes undercover as an intern to expose a massive money-fraud, a ruthless social climber, Reva, steals her identity as “Mrs. Talwar” and turns the office into a bullying circus. To save her marriage, her company—and her own name—Alisha must outplay the impostor and catch the laundering ring before it destroys her.

title: Ready Daddy Go!
description: One night, a strict corporate father and his rebellious teenage son mysteriously swap souls — forcing the dad to survive high school drama and the son to run a high-pressure office — only to discover that walking in each other’s shoes might be the only way to fix their broken bond.

title: Ek Anjana Rishta
description: Seven years after Diwali destroyed his life, billionaire Samrat Singh lives in guilt, believing his wife Shreya and their unborn child died in a tragic accident caused by his powerful father’s cruelty. Unknown to him, Shreya survived—left paralysed, traumatised, and living on the streets with her young daughter Jiya, who grows up scavenging bottles to keep her mother alive. Fate cruelly reunites them when Jiya steals Samrat’s ring to fund Shreya’s life-saving surgery, leading to humiliation, conflict, and heartbreak before the truth finally surfaces: Jiya is Samrat’s daughter, and Shreya is alive. As love, guilt, and redemption collide amid social cruelty and class divides, Aakhri Diya becomes a story of lost love, a child’s hope, and a broken family finding its way back to light.

title: Betrayed Heiress
description: Sakshi, who sacrificed everything for love, faces betrayal from her husband Vansh and his family. Humiliated and deceived, she rises with courage, reveals her true identity as the heir of SB Group, and reclaims her dignity and power.

title: College Romance Aur Dhoka
description: College Romance

title: One Last Chance [Hindi]
description:
One Last Chance is a gripping tale of love, choices, and the price of regret. A woman walks away from true love, only to realize later what she lost - as the man she left behind rebuilds his life in a deeply loving and affluent relationship. Passion, heartbreak, and high-stakes emotions collide in this drama that will keep you hooked at every turn.

An emotional rollercoaster and one of the most interesting watches of the year.

title: Lost In Love [Hindi]
description: Jab pyaar sirf ek emotion nahi, balki ek dangerous game ban jaata hai, tab har rishta ek nayi twist leta hai. Elle, Ethan aur Jannette ke beech ka yeh triangle sirf love story nahi, ek intense emotional rollercoaster hai jahan trust, betrayal aur revenge sab kuch hai. To ready ho jao ek gripping kahani ke liye jo har episode ke saath aur complicated hoti jaati hai. Abhi dekhna shuru kijiye.

title: Joker Ka Wild Card
description: Varun looks like a harmless, childlike man who has lost his memory, but behind that innocence lies a mysterious past and terrifying skill. When a ruthless gambling syndicate traps his wife’s family in an 8-crore debt, Varun steps onto the gambling table himself. With brilliant tricks and fearless mind games, he begins exposing the cheats of the underworld. But who is Varun really… and why does the gambling world fear the name Sikandar?

title: Dulhan Se Darling
description: Dulhan Se Darling is a fiery romantic drama of love, betrayal, and hidden identities. Kritika Reddy, heiress of a billion-dollar empire disguised as a cleaning staff, crosses paths with ruthless billionaire Rihaan Bhatt, sparking a storm of clashes, secrets, and undeniable attraction. But when her duplicitous fiancé and his mistress plot against her, Kritika must rise from humiliation to power—finding both revenge and unexpected love.

title: Undercover Agent: Mission Narmada Jail
description: A disgraced RAW commando infiltrates a high-security Indian prison to expose a terror network, but discovers the man who ruined his father’s name and his nation’s honour has been hiding in the same cell all along.

title: Secret Prince
description: So, our hero, born into a super-rich family, is about to be named the next heir to their business empire. But according to their family tradition, the person taking the position has to learn the ropes for 3 months by working at another business, hiding their real identity. That's exactly what our hero does.. He hides who he is and starts working at a business family's place. That's where he meets our heroine, who's already engaged to someone else. Love starts blooming in his heart, too. Now, what's our hero going to do? Is he going to stick to the family tradition? Or is he going to give up the family's custom to marry his girlfriend

title: The Magical Husband
description: A mischievous yet kind-hearted magician, Veer, is forced into a marriage with wheelchair-bound CEO Vaishali due to family greed and betrayal, turning two broken lives into an unlikely partnership. As conspiracies, poison plots, and humiliation surround them, Veer secretly uses his powers to protect Shaifali, while love slowly grows between duty, dignity, and destiny.

title: Billionaire Became Beggar
description: Aryan lives like a beggar—but hides a billionaire legacy. When Jhanvi insults him, she unknowingly steps into the world of a man who owns more than she can imagine. Billionaire Became Beggar is a fiery tale of secrets, ego clashes, and a love story born where judgment ends. Watch Now!

title: The Great Indian Cook
description:
Samy and Sarath are childhood friends, but their sons, Kathir and Dev, become rivals at the family restaurant. After Samy leaves and Sarath dies, Dev blames Kathir, while Kathir rises from a small roadside stall with his talent.
When they face each other on the Great Indian Kitchen stage, will jealousy win, or will true talent prove itself?

title: Mechanic Billa: Return of the Racing Legend
description: After five years in hiding, a legendary racer disguised as a mechanic must return to the track to save his village, igniting a high-octane rivalry with the current world champion. Watch now!

title: Billionaire Heist
description: A billionaire with unlimited funds but no proof, Dharam Khurana is trapped in a system that refuses to believe him. As hours tick down and humiliation piles up, one decision changes everything. What begins as a simple plea turns into a dangerous game of power, ego, and survival.

title: Dad With A Dark Side
description: Aravind Varma is an ordinary cleaner. Anu, the CEO of Aditya Group of Hotels, develops feelings for him. Even though he has a son who is of marriageable age, will Aravind marry Anu? The story revolves around the hidden secret in the life of an ordinary cleaner.

title: Shattered Bonds [Kannada]
description: When railway ticket checker (TT/ TC) Ishwar Pratap retires after 40 years of honest service, his three biological children reveal their cruel indifference, forcing him and his devoted wife Rajni into a humiliating separation - until his adopted son Prem and a book of love poems expose the truth about family, sacrifice, and the price of unconditional love.

title: The Sweeper Billionaire
description: Tarun, a wealthy heir rebelling against his mother’s arranged marriage plans, hides his identity as a cleaning staff. Sneha, an orphaned bride abandoned at the altar, impulsively proposes marriage to Neel. What begins as a marriage of convenience transforms into a journey of trust, loyalty, and love as they navigate class divides, hidden truths, and personal scars - proving that love can bloom in the most unexpected places. Watch Now!

title: The Street Beggar to Billionaire
description: The Street Beggar to Billionaire

title: Dhurandhar Shooter
description: Rohan, India’s best sniper, known as Gun Master G-9. After losing his mentor in a terror attack, Rohan gives up guns and hides his identity while working at a small shooting academy of his mentpr’s widow in Uttarakhand. When criminals, corrupt forces, and an international terror plan threaten an innocent family and the country’s future, Rohan must face his past. The story blends patriotism, sacrifice, family emotions, and revealing how a true warrior never stops protecting his people.

title: Still Waiting for Love [Kannada]
description: Still Waiting for Love

title: Secretary Rosie [Kannada]
description: She wasn’t just a secretary. She was temptation wrapped in silk, whispering promises that blurred the line between loyalty and lust. With every calculated smile, every lingering touch, she stepped deeper into his marriage—turning boardroom meetings into battles of desire, and home into a war zone. But how far would she go? To steal his property? To wear his wife’s crown? Or to seduce her way into a future where his empire bore her name alone?

title: A Wild Last Boss Appeared! [Hindi]
description: The last boss of a great battle with heroes returns 200 years after her defeat to explore the world and its changes since her time.

Watch FCM TV to see game guides, FCM LIVE streams & soccer match content from the world’s biggest leagues including the Premier League, LALIGA & MLS

COMPETE IN HEAD TO HEAD PVP

🧡 ■ "eFootball™" - An Evolution from "PES"
It's an all-new era of digital soccer: "PES" has now evolved into "eFootball™"! And now you can experience the next generation of soccer gaming with "eFootball™"!

■ Welcoming Newcomers
After downloading, you can learn the basic controls of the game via a step-by-step tutorial that includes practical demonstrations! Complete them all, and receive Lionel Messi!

[Ways of Playing]
■ Build Your Very Own Dream Team
You have a plethora of teams that can be chosen as your Base Team, including European and South American powerhouses, J.League and national teams!

■ Sign Players
After creating your team, it's time to get some signings in! From current superstars to soccer legends, sign players and take your team to new heights!

・ Special Player List
Here you can sign special players such as standouts from actual fixtures, players from featured leagues, and legends of the game!

・ Standard Player List
Here you can handpick and sign your favorite players. You can also use the Sort and Filter functions to narrow your search.

■ Playing Matches
Once you have built a team with your favorite players, it's time to take them to the field.
From testing your skills against the AI, to competing for ranking in Online Matches, enjoy eFootball™ the way you like!

・ Sharpen your skills in VS AI Matches
There are a variety of Events that coincide with the real-world soccer calendar, including a "Starter" Event for those just starting out, as well as Events where you can play against teams from high-profile leagues. Build a Dream Team that fits the Events' themes and take part!

・ Put your strength to the test in User Matches
Enjoy real-time competition with the Division-based "eFootball™ League" and a wide variety of weekly Events. Can you take your Dream Team to the pinnacle of Division 1?

・ Max 3 vs 3 matches with friends
Use the Friend Match feature to play against your friends. Show them the true colors of your well-developed team!
Cooperative matches up to 3 vs 3 are also available. Get together with your friends and enjoy some heated soccer action!

■ Player Development
Depending on Player Types, signed players can be further developed.
Level up your players by having them play in matches and by using in-game items, then utilize the acquired Progression Points to develop them to match your playing style.

[For More Fun]
■ Weekly Live Updates
Data from real matches being played around the world is collated on a weekly basis and implemented in-game through the Live Update feature to create a more authentic experience. These updates affect various aspects of the game, including player Condition Ratings and team rosters.

title: A Sense of a Maze
description: In this allegorical documentary we exercise a search for answers to life's unpronounced questions in the labyrinth of a medieval medina. The milestones of the quest are existential, scientific, religious and artistic expressions. Here colors, sounds, figures and authentic musical threads lead the wanderer. The verbal, as well as the visual and sonic guidance concerns eternal truth-seeking, fear, foreignness, the sacredness of life, the discovery of "otherness", the loss of the garden of Eden, inside and outside, work and worship, ecstasy and pacification.

title: a father a nation's eagle

title: Onde a Água Encontra a Terra
A Past, a Future and Destiny
description: An uncontrollable force of destiny controls a dirty politician's life leading him from a path of death to life.

title: A los 50, Volver a Empezar
description:
Justo después de heredar mil millones, Clara descubre el impactante secreto de su marido Luis, un matrimonio secreto con otra mujer. Ella está completamente decepcionada cuando descubre que su tan esperado embarazo terminó en un trágico aborto involuntario causado por Luis.
Después de reagruparse, Clara se embarca en un viaje de venganza...

title: A Horse of a Different Color
description: The film explores a friend's discovery of the world from the perspective of Jeffrey Watkins; a blind, disabled advocate, struggling to be 'normal' in an able bodied abnormal world.

title: Build a House, Plant a Tree
description: Juraj Jakubisko's first feature film after a forced nine-year-long break is a story about an unconventional man, Jozef Matús. He arrives to a small village in eastern Slovakia to settle down and start a family. He is ready to subordinate everything to his goal. It all starts with stealing building material and ends with him disregarding those close to him to a point where his ambitions are turning against him. Build a House, Plant a Tree is a viewer-friendly film with a plot resembling a western, including several attractive action sequences.

title: A Return
description: In a Tunisian village El Omrane in Sidi Bouzid (283 km from Tunis), massive arrests against young people who demonstrated their right to work. The elders of the town decide to start a hunger strike. Hamza 12, helps us discover the village, between resistance and memory.

title: A Series About A Series
description: Writer Buck Banderas transitions to filmmaking, and quickly learns of the many obstacles that stand in his way, like finding the right cast and crew, plus dealing with his own mental health issues that haunt him on a regular basis.

title: A Beautiful Mind... of a Gladiator
description: Maximus Nash is a brilliant mathematician who hears voices from Paul Hogan telling him to be rude and beat people up. In exchange for tutoring, Alice will attempt to teach him manners and get him off probation. The result: He let her into a world...only an A**hole could have imagined.

title: A Freira e a Tortura
description: Chief of Police Rui, a happily married man of principles, is in charge of investigating Joana, a teacher who's accused of political crimes. After some false starts, he manages to arrest her, but is startled to learn that she's also a nun. The revelation doesn't alter the natural course of events: he must torture her in order to obtain a confession, and gets increasingly attracted to her.

title: A Man and A Camera
description: Ordinary people suddenly find themselves face-to-face with a mysterious, silent camera operator.

title: A Lady Takes a Chance
description: Facing forty, a NYC spinster on a bus tour of the West encounters a handsome rodeo cowboy who helps her forget her unsuitable city suitors.

description: After death, 18th century wizard Elizabeth Starwhisperer wakes up in her modern-day reincarnation. In this life, she's faced with a divorce from the same man who loved her eternally. Can Liz regain her magic before dark forces prevail?

title: What Is a Man Without a Moustache?
description: A young widow, an aging widower-returnee, and a priest from a bankrupt parish are struggling to come to terms with the post-war environment, complete with its prejudices, illusions, and unpleasant mentality. What follows is a romantic comedy set in rough landscape, about a woman who falls in love with a local priest. He is not blind to her love, but is unable to choose between the church and her, until the circumstances force him to make his choice.

title: A Gentleman
description: Gaurav, a simple hard working guy for a white collar job visits Mumbai for a meeting where his doppelganger is about to bring chaos in his life.

title: A Nocturne
description: X and Z are a vampire couple, living in an old warehouse in inner-city Melbourne. Over the course of one night, they go about their regular business, teaming up with the poet-cannibal Seers and another vampire Vee. After a strange encounter with the mysterious Rola, the fabric of X and Z's world begins to change. A philosophical vampire film.

title: When a Feller Needs a Friend
description: Eddie wears a leg brace and his mother will not let him play like the other boys. His hope is that a German doctor will be able to operate and fix his leg. When his cousin Froggie comes to live with his family, he is nice to Mr. and Mrs. Randall, but mean to Eddie. Uncle Jonas sees what is happening, but Eddie's parents do not believe him as Froggie seems so nice. Uncle Jonas tries to make Eddie tougher by teaching him boxing and baseball, but all it does is get Jonas thrown out of the house.

title: When a Billionaire Met a Mafia Family On a Train
description: On a speeding train, a wounded young woman is brutally humiliated, branded a gold-digger, and nearly killed by a ruthless billionaire family—until a shocking truth explodes: the “helpless” girl they tortured is actually the only daughter of the powerful tycoon they’re desperate to marry into.

title: A Separation
description: A married couple are faced with a difficult decision - to improve the life of their child by moving to another country or to stay in Iran and look after a deteriorating parent who has Alzheimer's disease.

headers.User-Agent: com.community.oneroom/50020118 (Linux; U; Android 9; en_US; 23078RKD5C; Build/PQ3A.190605.03081104; Cronet/135.0.7012.3)

title: A Crowned Love, A Forbidden Fate
description:
Isolde Winslow, a fallen princess, lives under house arrest with her mother—until Crown Prince Edmund Sinclair, her family's enemy, begins to show her unexpected kindness. Though she resists, their bond deepens... until Isolde flees the palace, only to be captured by rebels.
 When Edmund risks his life to save her, Isolde must choose: Can she trust the man whose bloodline destroyed hers? Or is their love doomed from the start?

title: A Town and a Tall Chimney
description: The year is 1910. Sekine Saburo (Ide Asato) is a landowner's son living in a beautiful village within Ibaraki Prefecture. He is informed by a mining engineer of the dangers posed by the smoke pollution from the Hitachi Mine in the neighboring village. Furthermore, it is revealed permission to mine was granted by his grandfather (Nakadai Tatsuya) thirty years ago. Sekine gives up his dream to become a diplomat and decides to fight against air pollution.

title: A Chiara
description: Follows the story of 15-year-old Chiara whose close-knit family falls apart after her father abandons them in Calabria.

title: A Trilogy
description: Composed of fragments. Images are layered on each other provoking ideas of separation. Constructed around absences it ends with a series of questions about life and our perception of the way film constructs narratives.

title: Nabar: A Rebel with a Cause
description: 'NABAR' is the story of Surjan Singh, a Father, who became a Fighter from a Farmer to fight against Injustice. 'NABAR' is the story of Chindo, a mother, who got stuck in the most important moment of her life. Her son's marriage. 'NABAR' is the story of Manjeet, a girlfriend, who thinks death can kill life, but not relationship. 'NABAR' is the story of Karam, who has a dream to go abroad and earn a better living for his family. 'NABAR' is the story of Kapura, a politician, who can go to any extent for his profits. 'NABAR' is the story of Rana, a struggling comedian with golden heart, who will stand by truth at any cost. 'NABAR' is the story which has never been told before. Full of emotions, love, anger and happiness. 'NABAR' is the story with soulful music (romantic, Bhangra, shabad and chandi di war first time in Punjabi film.

title: A Little Girl in a Big City
description: Small-town girl Mary Barry wins a beauty contest and goes to New York to meet D. V. Cortelyou, the magazine's publisher. Greatly taken by young girl, Cortelyou arranges for her to live with Dolly Griffith, a woman of questionable reputation who often aids him in his wicked schemes of blackmail and seduction. During a party seemingly in Mary's honor, Cortelyou obtains some apparently compromising evidence with which to blackmail Mrs. Young, the wife of a wealthy broker; Cortelyou then makes rough advances toward Mary, and one of his assistants, Jack McGuire, gives him a good beating. Threatened with blackmail, Mrs. Young turns in desperation to Jack for help. Jack and Mary attempt to trap Cortelyou in a net of his own making, but the blackmailer is too smart, outwitting Jack and abducting Mary. Cortelyou also kidnaps Mrs. Young, keeping her and Mary in a deserted house. Jack learns of their whereabouts and arrives with the police. Cortelyou is arrested, Mrs. Young is saved from the consequences of scandal, and Jack proposes to Mary.

title: A Profetisa
description:
Eis a lenda:
Na Antiguidade, a vidente Elara Valente, para salvar o povo da calamidade, desfez sua própria divindade em doze fragmentos — o Olho Onisciente, que penetrava os desígnios do céu; o Sopro Divino, que desafiava a morte; o Guerreiro Eterno, invencível —, dando origem às doze grandes casas aristocráticas.
Sessenta anos depois, ela retorna. De cabelos brancos até os ombros e com um véu negro sobre os olhos, em sua forma mortal.
O comandante de ferro Xavier Cael é designado para vigiá-la. Mas, passo a passo, torna-se seu principal guarda-costas… e seu mais devoto crente.
Desta vez, ela não vem apenas para recolher os fragmentos.
Vem para reescrever as regras deste mundo.

title: Confundiram a Criada com a Senhora —— A Verdadeira Herdeira é Inalcançável
description: A bilionária Elisa está prestes a se casar com o namorado. Para apoiar a carreira dele, ela mantém um perfil discreto e vai ao aeroporto buscar sua futura sogra, Lola George. Esnobe, Lola confunde Lydia Harris, amante de Cody, toda produzida e cheia de bajulação, com a futura nora, a presidente do Grupo White. Ao mesmo tempo, toma Rachel pela amante e a humilha sem piedade.

title: Emanuelle - A Woman from a Hot Country
description: A man and a woman (Whitman & Gemser), both with checkered pasts, hitch a ride together. While on the trip both begin to converse about their most recent relationship. Through flashbacks the 2 describe how their relationships became unraveled and why they are in their current situations. Near the end of the trip they realize they have much in common and a strong bond begins to develop.

title: A Herança
description: The Heritage focus on the lives of two sisters, Maria and Luciana, who grew up unaware of the frightening reality manipulated by their family for their own good, making them live in different worlds of illusion. The older sister, Maria, is an innocent and idealistic woman who is not even able to imagine the crimes committed so she could enjoy her privileged lifestyle. However the younger sister, Luciana, is a hedonistic, cynical and emotionally dysfunctional person, that uses sex and drugs to hide herself from responsibility and fears. Neither Maria nor Luciana are prepared when they suddenly inherit their grandfather's business and end up in a dangerous game of intrigue, manipulation and mystery. The Heritage will also discuss the future of water and the preservation of lands for conscious use. A social inheritance from the past, with nuances around the interests that affects all of us. "YOUR HERITAGE ISN'T MONEY, YOUR HERITAGE IS A SOCIAL COMMITMENT"

title: A Valentine’s Day, A Prize, and Mr.right
description: On Valentine’s Day, Livia catches her boyfriend Ryder cheating with her stepsister Bianca. Shattered and drunk, she runs into Caspian, CEO of Martin Group. He recognizes her instantly—the woman he’s loved for ten years—and proposes without hesitation. Livia agrees for one reason only: a luxury villa prize tied to the marriage. Cast out by her family, humiliated at work by Bianca—who flaunts herself as the CEO’s wife—Livia has no clue she’s already the real Mrs. Vanderbilt. To claim the villa, Livia must live with Caspian for 90 days Under Caspian's quiet, relentless pursuit, Livia gradually falls in love with him. Grace, Ryder, and Bianca build their future on a lie. When the truth comes out, it destroys them all.

title: B'T X
description: The story follows Teppei, a caretaker of a farm located in Kamui Island. He visits his genius brother who studies robotics in Germany only to see him get abducted by a group of half human half machine beings. Using a powerful weapon he calls the Meisei Fist, he attempts to hunt them down and rescue his brother.

title: Studio B

title: B & B

description: When three young martial artists embark on a relentless treasure hunt in order to free their friend from the grasp of a ruthless gangster, they get entangled in a complex conspiracy staged to dethrone Berlin's underworld kingpin.

title: Laila B.
description: Since surviving a physical assault on the steps of her South Boston apartment, Laila Bataglia (30) has been keeping a low profile. She spends her days hiding behind her social media persona and struggles to make ends meet as a freelance writer and part-time bartender at The Clock Tower, where she works with her ever-supportive best friend, Patrice. When a young woman turns up dead in her neighborhood, Laila is forced to face her fears again, revealing that her real fight is far from over. Inspired by true events and melding narrative with cinema verite, LAILA B. is writer, director, actor Amy DePaola's meditation on reclaiming one's power in an uncontrollable modern world.

title: 127 B
description: 127B Film Synopsis: Hyderabad and its old city, One Story that explores 3 people lives in the extremities of human behavior involving social and economical distress. A fight between myths, integrity and characters. As the three friends find short way which can make them rich overnight. How this twisting ride does turns to a horrific experience and lands them into chaos. Three people's adventure and what it leads to is a fun to watch story. One story, two extremes, seven gates and Blind myth.

title: Generation B
description: When Belgium's credit rating is lowered from AA+ to B, a crisis affecting mostly young people erupts. While the gap between baby boomers and youngsters grows, Jonas tries to win back his ex-girlfriend.

title: Plan B

title: B.B. Fish
description: Ushio is a freediver with strange powers. He and his friends are at a tropical land in search of a rare fish, the Blue Butterfly. This pursuit leads them to Ayuuru, a local girl who might know where to find the legendary fish.

title: B/B
description: The 2020 Tokyo Olympics are cancelled due to ministerial corruption, and there has been an attempted spraying of poisonous gas by a new religion. In the shadow of these two incidents, the murder of a convenience store owner has drawn a limited response from police and press but a suspect in the killing has been found: high school girl Sanagi (Karen), a loner who had an exchange with the victim's young son Shiro (NAKAZAWA Koshin). The axis of the film is her questioning by a psychiatrist and a detective but it won't be easy since she is suffering from multiple personality disorder and her personalities each emerge at random to recollect what happened from their respective perspectives.

title: B&W
description: Swaranjali is a painter with aspirations of becoming one of the world's greatest painters. During this process, she develops a new type of live musical painting in which she paints while dancing to the music. Vardhan is an aspiring music director who works for film industry. Due to lack of opportunities, he was unable to become what he desired, and in his frustration, he became addicted to drugs. Yamini, as a singer, aspires to reach greater heights in the music industry with her singing talent. She hangs out a lot and doesn't take things seriously in the process, all three become good friends, and because Swaranjali and Vardhan love each other, they begin a living relationship, with Swaranjali morally and financially supporting Vardhan. In the process of introducing her live music painting theme to the world, she meets famous event organizer Rakesh, but Rakesh, being a playboy, wants every girl to be around him rather than helping them. As a neighbor, Papua irritates Swaranjali by knowing about her relationship with Vardhan and tries to attract her while she avoids him. Swaranjali planned a surprise party for Vardhan's birthday and invites all for the party. Vardhan was discovered dead in Swaranjali house on the same day.How does Swaranjali get out of this murder mystery and achieve her goal?

title: Akce B
description: Two years after the end of the Second World War, the remnants of Ukrainian Insurgence Army, called the Bandera's after their former commander Stepan Bandera, are trying to get from Poland through Slovakia to Germany in the West. They resort to sabotages also on Czechoslovak territory, and therefore army and police units are deployed to capture them. Soldiers and policemen are warned about the danger of encountering spies and collaborators of the Bandera's. In the meantime police investigators are arresting catholic clergy for supplying the saboteurs with weapons and false documents. Soldiers are operating in the area of Small Fatra, and it seems there must be someone amongst them who provides the Bandera's with information about planned movements of the army.

title: C-Bear and Jamal
description: Jamal passes through his 10th birthday, and in the process of 'becoming a man', which is what this milestone means, he tries to give up childhood things, including C Bear, his teddy bear. C Bear and Jamal talk to each other, and C Bear can create imaginary scenarios for Jamal - he shows Jamal what adulthood can mean, and how passing 10 does not mean that all of childhood must be abandoned.

title: C/O Kaadhal [Hindi]
description: A heart warming film that explores the concept of romance with episodes involving four sets of people of different age group.

title: Tiovivo c. 1950
description: Madrid, the capital of Spain in the 50s, it is still in a latent postwar period. A carousel of several survivors try to make a living in a gloomy country.

title: 96°C Café
description: 96°C Café is set against the backdrop of a homely café, owned by married couple Liqiao (Desmond Tan) and Xijie (Paige Chua). When Xijie meets with an accident, she stops working at the café and things start to change. As Xijie becomes more forlorn and withdrawn, Liqiao over time develops an unlikely affinity with Yuchen (Julie Tan), a fine arts student hired to help out in the café. With an unexpected twist at the end of the mini drama, this is a contemporary love story which brings cheers and tugs at the heartstrings of viewers.

title: Housing Complex C
description: Follows Kimi, as trouble seems to follow her wherever she goes, and now horrific incidents begin to happen in the small housing complex where she lives - is an ancient evil stalking the residents of Housing Complex C?

description: It tells the story of a pair of mortal enemies who accidentally became a couple but fell in love with each other in a series of bizarre cases and finally chose to fight side by side.

title: Capital C
description: CAPITAL C is the first documentary about crowdfunding. It follows the hopes and dreams as well as the fears and pitfalls of a whole new generation of independent creators, who reach out to the crowd in order to change their lives forever.

title: Rab C. Nesbitt
description: Rab C. Nesbitt is lowlife scum (and proud of it) in Glasgow, Scotland who spends his time drinking in his local and speaking to the camera about the state of society as he sees it.

title: Blossoms in Adversity
description: Inspired by Mulan, Hua Zhi, a brave and intelligent aristocratic girl, expected to live a quiet life, employs everything that she has learnt but never got to use to save her family when tragedy strikes, taking away all their privileges.

title: My Stepbrother by Day, My Forbidden Lover by Night
description: On a first-class flight to her mother’s wedding, broke scholarship student Lily spends one reckless night with Ryder, an irresistible football star. By morning, she plans to forget him—until she arrives at her new home and discovers he is her future stepbrother. Lily vows to stay away to protect her mother’s hard-won happiness, but Ryder refuses to pretend they are family.

title: Beauty of Resilience
description: A long-disappeared sign of Phoenix appears among a group of teenagers in the triennially held ceremony for mortals, who are then sent to learn immortal arts. The heavenly realm sends Sun God disguised as their teacher to investigate this.

title: When C Goes with G7
description: When a heartbroken film school graduate, an unemployed UC Berkeley MBA graduate and a junior high school student converge at the music instruments store of an aspiring musician, quirky thoughts on everything from work and education to love and life emerge against a truly catchy soundtrack. Relationships end and hopes are occasionally dashed in this episodic drama, but few could complain that this isn't a thoughtful attempt to capture the sentiments of growing up in Hong Kong as we know it today.

title: Oops! The Alpha's Bride Is a Boy
description: After an unforgettable night with a mysterious man, Fenrir never expects to see him again—until he discovers the stranger is Lucien, the powerful Alpha of the Lusen Family. When Fenrir's twin sister Chloe elopes, he is forced to take her place in a one-month trial marriage with Lucien. Now he must keep his true identity hidden as their forbidden bond grows and the power buried within him begins to awaken.

title: C-38: The Search for Marriage
description: On June 22nd, 2005, Bill C-38 passed a final reading in the House of Commons, making Canada the fourth country in history to officially sanction same-sex marriages. Some saw it as the final hurdle in a 40-year marathon for equality. To others, it undermined an age-old building block of society. This controversial legislation continues to divide the country, and indeed the world, in half. Through interviews with the public as well as experts in various fields, 'C-38: The Search for Marriage' challenges common notions about marriage, sexuality and equality to answer these and other fundamental questions from an equal and fair perspective.

title: Mayans M.C. S5
description: A prospect in the Mayans M.C. charter on the California-Mexico border struggles with his desire for vengeance against the cartel and his need for respect from the women he loves.

title: Tales of Demons and Gods [English] S1-S9
description: In his past life, although too weak to protect his home when it counted, out of grave determination Nie Li became the strongest Demon Spiritist and stood at the pinnacle of the martial world. However, he lost his life during the battle with the Sage Emperor and six deity-ranked beasts. His soul was then brought back to when he was still 13 years old. Although he's the weakest in his class with the lowest talent, having only a red soul realm and a weak one at that, with the aid of the vast knowledge which he accumulated from his previous life, he decided to train faster than anyone could expect. He also decided to help those who died nobly in his previous life to train faster as well. He aims to protect the city from the coming future of being devastated by demon beasts and the previous fate of ending up destroyed. He aims to protect his lover, friends, family and fellow citizens who died in the beast assault or its aftermath. And he aims to destroy the so-called Sacred family who arrogantly abandoned their duty and betrayed the city in his past life.

title: Dragon King's Forbidden Lover
description: Drugged by her stepmother, a witch flees to Dragon's Breath Canyon and forms a fated mate bond with Dragon King Ryder after one night. Five years later, she returns as a maid to save her mixed-blood son, Leon. Though Sophia’s lies make Ryder cold and suspicious, their bond endures. As a bloodline crisis, black-market kidnapping, and wedding-day rebellion expose the truth, Eve and Leon awaken ancient powers and, with Ryder, defeat the darkness to claim eternal happiness.

title: H.C. Andersen's The Long Shadow
description: A young man discovers that his shadow does not behave quite like others, but is a reflection of his dark and unruly side shaking of his life. When he is struggling to create a name for himself as a writer, the shadow acquire it's own body, in league with the devil. The life and times of the reclusive Danish writer, Hans Christian Andersen.

title: C'est Si Bon
description: When country boy Oh Geun-tae is thrust into the bustling world of Seoul's iconic folk music café-C'est Si Bon, he unwittingly becomes the third member of the yet-to-debut 'C'est Si Bon Trio'.

title: Love is Sweet
description: It follows the story of a girl named Jiang Jun who meets her close childhood friend, Ma Yuanshuai, in the workplace-this time, however, not as an ally but as a rival - Jiang Jun is an educated woman with a double degree in economics and psychology. Her parents liberal ways of raising her gave rise to her strong, independent, and idealistic character. After graduating from college, she begins to work for a non-profit organization to follow her dream of helping others. However, her father's sudden death leaves her on a crucial crossroad in her life. She decides to join MH, a top investment company, to fulfill her father's dying wish. Jiang Jun runs into her childhood friend Ma Yuanshuai, yet he's different from the gentle and caring protector that she remembered him to be. He is now her rival at work. Furthermore, someone seems to be plotting against her and she must rely on her wits and will to succeed not just in her career, but also in love.

title: Who Stole My AC in 40°C Heat?
description: Marco, an appliance dealer who rose from the bottom, returned to his old apartment building and paid out of his own pocket to install air conditioners for every household, as a way of repaying the kindness he had received years ago. However, his neighbor Marina took the lead in filing claims under various pretexts and engaging in moral blackmail. Without arguing, Marco dismantled all the air conditioners overnight and took them away. When the scorching heat arrived, the old building suffered terribly, while the new building across the street remained cool and orderly. After enduring heatstroke, shortages, and failed extortion attempts, the neighbors finally broke down and had no choice but to turn to Marco for help. Marco presented them with a business contract and insisted that things be done according to the rules. In the end, the neighbors paid to have the units reinstalled—except for Anna, the only one who had stayed clear-headed back then, and who received Marco's free, special care.

title: Louis C.K. Oh My God
description: In February, 2013, Louis brings his impish nihilism to Phoenix, Arizona. He talks about an old lady and her pet, living in Manhattan, experiencing his body's aging (he's 45), men's fascination with women's breasts, the beauty of living outside the food chain, his quickness to anger while driving, and murder. It's theater in the round, so he's in constant motion, a grin nearly always on his face.

title: CEO's Cute Charm For Love
description: Song Yujia and Lu Huanyu's new drama begins with a special marriage. In the marriage, the man went abroad with a third party, and the two lived based on an agreement not to interfere with each other. The heroine Xu Wenyan chose to support a gigolo in response. Two years later, when her husband, who was married in disguise, returned to China, it foreshadowed the resurgence of this complicated relationship - Xu Wenyan's relationship with the gigolo came to an end. At the same time, the prince of the Beijing circle, who had been silently supporting the heroine, decided not to hide his true feelings and identity anymore, and strived to spend the rest of his life with the heroine as a formal partner, starting a battle for love and identity.

title: Perfect and Casual
description: It tells the romantic story between Zhang Sinian, the aloof and monastic "Mr. Perfect" and Yun Shu, the laid-back and cheerful "Miss Almost".

title: No Sword Can Rival Hers
description: At five, she slew a dragon—then hid her sword for thirteen years. Old law: women who wield swords are crippled or killed. Her aunt won a duel disguised as a man; she was broken and jailed for thirteen years. Now her family falls. Vera disguises as Gavin, sweeps the royal trials, and when orcs storm the capital, she kills the Orc King. The old law dies. Girls can wield swords openly—and Vera frees her aunt.

title: Super Cube
description: A boy gets cosmic powers from an alien cube. After winning his crush's love, he faces a rival and growing threats. When she's taken to another realm, he begins a rescue mission that shapes his values.

title: Hear Me, Mommy? Now Let's Get Rich!
description: The Goddess of Wealth, Ann Lowe, is reincarnated as Eva Shaw’s unborn daughter, whom she is carrying in her womb. Ann soon learns that the powerful Lowe family and her father, Cory Lowe, plan to cast Eva aside because she is carrying a daughter. From within the womb, Ann guides Eva to build a fortune in stocks and shine at auctions. Mother and daughter join forces to defeat her biased father and rise to become the world’s top billionaires.

title: Against the Current
description: Shen Jialan, once a nobleman's granddaughter, falls from grace after her family is falsely accused of treason. Abandoned by her fiancé Lin Jinqi, she is forced to assume a servant's identity in his household. Despite hardships, she refuses to bow to fate. With resilience and wit, she rises above class barriers, wins Lin Jinqi's heart, earns the family's respect, and ultimately clears her family's name.

title: [ENG DUB] Against the Odds: Cici's Second Act
description: In her past life, Cici was killed by her husband, Yates. However, she miraculously reincarnated and returned to the day she first met Yates's family. This time, Cici decisively chose Yates' uncle, Benson. Despite rumors claiming that Benson was sterile, Cici found herself pregnant with triplets and was spoiled by Benson!

title: Fini le Lèche-Bottes, Vive la Richesse ( Doublé )
description: Pendant 3 ans, Loïc Gaillard court après Rosa Lecomte, la star de la fac, qui finit par le larguer sans pitié. Dans sa détresse, il active un « système de larbin ». Mais Loïc, qui en a assez de ramper, décide d'exploiter un bug du système pour empocher d'énormes sommes d'argent, et pour s'acheter tout ce qu'il désire. Convaincu que ce choix égoïste le condamnera à finir seul, il finit par comprendre : quand on investit en soi, les beautés se pressent naturellement !

title: Stellar Transformation S1-S6
description: In order to gain the respect of his father, a kid without innate ability to practice internal techniques, resolutely chooses to follow the more difficult path of practicing external techniques. Will he be able to gain his father's respect?

title: Till I See You
description: Song Yi, a wealthy young man raised in Japan, travels to Northern China in search of answers about his father's past and unexpectedly becomes Xu Feiyu's temporary caregiver. Recovering from eye surgery with his eyes still covered in bandages, Feiyu slowly lowers his guard under Song Yi's domineering yet tender care. Before they can truly "see" each other, they have already fallen in love.

title: Salad Days
description: "Salad Days: A Decade of Punk in Washington, DC (1980-90)" examines the early DIY punk scene in the Nation's Capital. It was a decade when seminal bands like Bad Brains, Minor Threat, Government Issue, Scream, Void, Faith, Rites of Spring, Marginal Man, Fugazi, and others released their own records and booked their own shows-without major record label constraints or mainstream media scrutiny. Contextually, it was a cultural watershed that predated the alternative music explosion of the 1990s (and the industry's subsequent implosion). Thirty years later, DC's original DIY punk spirit serves as a reminder of the hopefulness of youth, the power of community and the strength of conviction.

title: Mudhal Kanave
description: The movie begins in Kanyakumari where Hari (Vikranth) settles down as painter for his livelihood. He comes across Jennifer (Honey Rose) and gets attracted by her. A sequence of events reveals that she is a married woman. She is the wife of David (Yugendhran) in the same village. Hari opens his heart to his employer (Manivann). A flashback reveals that Hari and Jennifer had been in love for a long time. A sequence of events leaves Jennifer mistaking Hari for no fault of him. She gets married and settles down in Kaniyakumari. Hari is hopeful that he would woo back Jennifer. The rest of the event is all but how Jennifer and Hari get united.

title: The Magic Brush Millionaire: Drawing My Superstar Lover
description: Broke street artist Chris receives a magical brush that brings anything he paints to life. After creating a living portrait of Hollywood superstar Shirley, he uses his gift to rise from poverty, defeat a corrupt gallery owner and a controlling agent, and protect the real Shirley. As miracles blur the line between art and reality, Chris builds an artistic empire—and wins the heart of the woman who inspired it all.

title: Fake Marriage with My CEO Bestie
description: Si-Ah has no idea that her childhood friend Jun-Woo has been in love with her all his life. So when Si-Ah approaches Jun-Woo to propose a contract marriage to fool her parents, he jumps at the chance. Even though they try to keep things platonic, the more time they spend together, the more uncertain their relationship becomes.Why do you have to keep kissing me? And why am I starting to like it?

title: Echoes of a Daydream
description: A troubled young man gets the unique opportunity to spend one more day with his deceased mother before she returns to heaven.

title: [Doublé] Le Dragon Furtif Est De Retour
description: Quentin Fèvre, le Roi des Mercenaires, est las des conflits. Un simple contrôle de sécurité révèle son identité stupéfiante. Alors qu'un contrat de mariage est prévu avec Céline Seguin, héritière de la famille Seguin, Quentin découvre que la jeune femme est entourée de dangers. Il utilise ses propres méthodes pour aider Céleste Seguin, mais se retrouve entraîné malgré lui dans une conspiration bien plus vaste. Face à chaque piège, Quentin Fèvre riposte, surmonte les périls et parvient à se sortir de situations difficiles.

title: It's My Turn
description: A successful but stressed mathematics professor goes to her father's wedding and falls in love with the son of her new stepmother.

title: Oh No I Slept With My Bestie's Tyrant Dad
description: Oh No I Slept With My Bestie's Tyrant Dad

title: [Doublé] Il ne reste plus toi dans ma vie
description:
Sophie, véritable dirigeante du Groupe Célestia, avait renoncé à son rôle au sommet de l’entreprise afin de soutenir son mari Alex. Elle s’était volontairement retirée pour devenir femme au foyer, et avait consacré sept années entières à prendre soin de sa famille. Elle avait même veillé sur Alex lorsqu’il avait été gravement malade, l’ayant accompagné sans relâche jusqu’à sa guérison, en y mettant toute son énergie et toute sa tendresse.



Cependant, cet amour qu’elle avait donné sans compter s’était transformé en une trahison totale. Le jour même de la cérémonie des cent jours de leur fils Léo, Alex a ramené sa maîtresse Emma ainsi que son fils illégitime Félix. Sous la complaisance de ses parents, Alex a imposé à Sophie un choix injuste : soit accepter la cohabitation avec Emma et Félix et continuer à servir la famille Bernard, soit divorcer sans pouvoir emmener son enfant.

title: Cupid's Chocolates S1-S2
description: High school student Jiang Hao Yi unexpectedly becomes the "Harem King", receiving confessions from beautiful girls he doesn't know. Perplexed by this strange situation, he tries to unravel the mystery.

title: Mecha Underdog
description: Jax Thorne, the legendary 5-time mecha champion, was betrayed and discarded by his club for being "too old." Left penniless, he’s taken in by Amy, the beautiful owner of a failing gym, hiding his identity as a humble mechanic. But when ruthless rivals push Amy to the brink, the King must rise. With his secret SSS-class mecha, Phoenix, Jax is ready to crush his betrayers and claim his queen!

title: Only Tamed for You
description: Joan White, heir to the White Group, was betrayed by her sister and fiancé, left for dead at sea. She survived, but with the mind of a child. Taken in by the mysterious Tommy Frim, they married in a flash. He doted on her, and love quietly bloomed.But after a blow to the head at a party,Joan's memories return. With her past restored, will her revenge begin?

title: Coroner's Diary
description: It's about a girl who joins hands with a prince, basically using her medical and crime solving skills to solve murder cases and also find the culprit who framed her father

title: Oops, I’m the Billionaire You Dumped
description: Before leaving for Africa, Kang Do-hyun proposed to Kim Ji-min. Five years later he returns; Ji-min, now a Harvard PhD, dumps him for a chaebol heir—never asking who he really is: the chairman of Titan Group. Flying home, heiress of Summit Group, Lee Chae-won, begs him for a one-year contract marriage. He refuses, but secretly rewrites her 100-billion proposal into 1,000 trillion. Mocked as a fraud, he hides his name—until the truth breaks, and everyone who mocked him kneels.

title: Sniper Butterfly
description: When Jin Cen falls into a low point in her life, she receives a call for help from Wu Li, a rural boy she once supported. Wu Li's spirit of self-reliance moves Jin Cen, prompting her to bring Wu Li, who is about to drop out of school and has no one to rely on, to the city for education. Six years later, Wu Li, now a successful professional, returns to the city and reunites with Jin Cen due to work. While he doesn't mention the past on the surface, his feelings of love remain deep inside. Encouraged by Wu Li's sincerity and bravery, Jin Cen chooses to respond to love truthfully.

title: Blossoms of Power
description: The sole survivor of a bloodshed, Qingzhi Gu awakens under a new identity as Xihe Shen, the Princess of the Northwest. Once a proud and spirited rose of the frontier, she has now transformed into a cold, calculating figure, determined to seize control of her destiny and dominate the game of power. Crown Prince Huayong Xiao, frail in body but razor-sharp in mind, sees through the treacherous currents of the court. As their fates intertwine, they grow closer, joining forces to command the winds of destiny.

title: The Heir
description: In the middle of Ming Dynasty, a tribute ink case broke the long-standing pattern of Huizhou ink industry, and Li Mo, a century-old family of ink making, fell to the altar. Li Mo's vitality was greatly damaged, and the ink industry of the Luo family rose, and the scenery was no two after Li Mo. Finally, due to the involvement of the government, the family was also destroyed. As time goes by, Li Zhen (Yang Zi is acted the role of), the eighth female of the Li clan, resolutely embarked on the road of making ink to solve the livelihood, and became the dark horse of Huizhou ink industry with talent and efforts. Luo Wenqian, the second son of the Locke family (Han Dongjun is acted the role of) to restore the layout of the family business, to stir up the pattern of Huizhou ink industry. They two people and ink industry upstart field ink family battle of wits and courage, Li Mo back to the top. In the face of the challenges of overseas ink industry, Li Zhen collected the essence of Huizhou ink industry, produced top ink products, and won the reputation of "the first ink in the world" for Huizhou ink. Li Zhen and Luo Wenqian finally got married and worked together to promote the passing down of Huizhou ink to the world.

title: Werewolf King's Hidden Heir
description: Human girl Nellie, drunk, stumbles into werewolf king Clifford's territory, has a one-night stand with him, and flees. Five years later, she applies to be his family doctor for her sick son Brady—only to discover her employer is the man from that night. Recognizing her, Clifford relentlessly pursues her while Brady's werewolf blood awakens. Werewolf nobles repeatedly frame Brady as a "cursed child" and try to kill him, but Clifford protects his family. At their wedding, he exposes the conspiracy and proves Brady's pure lineage. Nellie accepts his proposal, Brady gains the pack's acceptance, and the three live happily ever after.

title: The Land of Warriors
description: After the finals, Tang San parts ways with friends for five years of training. He reunites them to form the Tang Sect and confront Bibi Dong's sinister ambitions, protecting the Douluo Continent.

title: Rejected Siren, Chosen by the Prince
description: Voiceless Alicia trusts Rayne, unaware she's a pawn in his revenge. Forced to marry the "Mad Prince" Kane, she's framed and tortured as Rayne watches. Her hidden bloodline awakens. At Rayne's engagement, she exposes the lies, leaving proudly with Kane. Kane isn't mad—just tormented by the sea's cries—and together they heal. Consumed by obsession, Rayne wages war for her but fails. He's imprisoned; Shelly ruined. Voice restored, Alicia guards the deep sea with Kane.

title: The Hidden God-Tier Dragon Knight

title: Married to a Billionaire in Disguise
description: On the eve of her wedding, Emily Green catches her fiancé cheating. In a fit of anger, she impulsively marries a handsome beggar she meets by chance. What starts as a simple life with a doting husband takes a shocking turn when she discovers her "beggar" husband is actually a billionaire CEO!

title: The Princess's Gambit
description: A former princess enters an arranged marriage with a prime minister. Amidst political turmoil, she navigates loyalty conflicts, vengeance, and love while he conceals patriotic motives behind his ambitions.

title: Roses for My Little Moon
description: At 15, Evan Jose met the love of his life. Having been diagnosed with a rare illness since childhood and given no more than 30 years to live, Evan tasted a candy from Tina Skyler, and that very candy drove away his misery. Over the years, Evan kept supporting Tina, watching his little moon grow into an exceptional dancer. When he had only 7 months left to live, he made a selfish decision. He married her, aiming to love her silently, as he had done for the past 14 years. But he forgot that the look of love can't be hidden. His feelings grew stronger. He reveled in her cute yet awkward attempts to please him, was captivated by her unintentional touches, and couldn't bear the thought of any other man near Tina. With his life slipping away and his love impossible to let go, a countdown of love began.

title: Quantum G-d
description: Quantum G-d is a 96 pages script and a presentation deck, for a science documentary, written, from the scientific optics, by scientists from the California Institute of Technology, Caltech, listed as the most important institute of technology in the world, and one of the main universities along with Harvard, MIT and Oxford. Throughout the script, the physicists formulate questions and provide the answers through different professional perspectives according to each area of study. This is accompanied with a series of mind blowing, never before seen animations that will be used in schools to teach quantum physics for an entire generation. The script, which includes the pointed questions and the novel animations, will challenge the top minds in theoretical physics to re-evaluate our ideas of how the universe works through the lens of quantum entanglement. One of the writers serves as the manager for Caltech's Institute for Quantum Information and Matter, and he was a scientific consultant in Marvel's blockbuster movies, including Ant Man, Spider Man Homecoming, Ant Man and the Wasp, Infinity War, Captain Marvel, Doctor Strange, Avengers: Endgame and Fantastic Voyage (dir: Guillermo del Toro, prod: James Cameron). The narrative was constructed with the help of another scientist, a cell and molecular pathologist and research associate at the Doheny Eye Institute in Los Angeles, who co-wrote the viral shorts films, "Anyone Can Quantum" and "Quantum is Calling" which featured Stephen Hawking, Paul Rudd, Keanu Reeves, Zoe Saldana, Simon Pegg and John Cho respectively.

description: Computers, smart phones, and tablets are now a part of our daily lives. They have revolutionised the way we work, the way we communicate and the way we view the world. title: F**k Buddies
description: F*ck Buddies, we see a middle-aged man on his couch drinking a glass of scotch, when his daughter walks in, sits next to him and takes a swig. "How's your sex life?," he asks her, matter-of-factly. They drone on about his date and her new friends and when the scene ends, she replies, "to answer your question, it's going pretty amazing." The effect the show is going for is cool and casual; just a father-daughter duo knocking back after a tough day at work. But then you watch it again and notice that there's nothing else in the scene. It doesn't lead to anything nor does it reveal something new about Jiah (Jikki Nair), the show's protagonist. And when you realize that the father doesn't get a second scene in the show, you sense a problem. The scene was written exclusively for its shock value. Which is ok if the show was trying to achieve something that was truly shocking. Even its central concept, about two friends "benefitting" with no strings attached, isn't exactly fresh. title: I Remember When I Die
description: If the human concept of time ceases at the moment of death, is it then physically possible to experience eternity? Can we affect this last moment in life? Can we build our own eternity? 'I Remember When I Die' takes partly place at life's last destination, a hospice - and is partly shot in a land of memories and provocative choices. We meet the patients, their stand-ins and their dreams. Death is a process. Not black and white. If you could hold on to a memory forever, which one would it be? A highly original journey into the mystery of consciousness.

title: I Against I
description: Focusing on the timeless themes of jealousy, murder and betrayal, 'I Against I' is set over one night and utilises different time lines to reveal a dark and unexpected conclusion to a simple mystery premise. title: The High Frontier: The Untold Story of Gerard K. O'Neill
description: The High Frontier: The Untold Story of Gerard K. O'Neill tells the untold story of the life and influence of the late physicist and space colony pioneer Dr. Gerard K. O'Neill. In 1977, O'Neill wrote the book The High Frontier: Human Colonies in Space, which sparked an enormous grassroots movement to build Earth-like habitats in space in order to solve Earth's greatest crises. The film is told through "Gerry's Kids'' as they affectionately call themselves; his peers, family, and the younger generation who followed that movement and are now leading the modern day space industry.

title: Summertime
description: Yeo Eun Ho and Cha Do Hyeon have been friends all their lives. After 19 years, Eun Ho seems to have a good grasp on Do Hyeon, even knowing that his “perfect” image at school is a facade. But what Eun Ho is absolutely oblivious to is the fact that Do Hyeon has had an obsessive crush on him for years. Though Do Hyeon has been able to keep it a secret in order to slowly ease his way into Eun Ho’s heart, the sudden arrival of a new student named Kwon Yi Hyeon throws a wrench into his plans. What will Do Hyeon do to keep Eun Ho by his side? And will Eun Ho ever realize his best friend’s feelings for him?

title: Badla
description: Ramnagar is a simple beautiful village. Bharati Devi is a very honourable and respected Lady who loves her village. She is the chief of the local Panchayat of Ramnagar. She always backs the rights of the common people. Bharti devi lives in a very expanded family with all his sons and daughter. Sonaton is a very cruel and dishonest person who believes that Bharti Devi is responsible for his father's death. But everybody knows that was a mere accident. Sonaton conspires against her and tries to grab the property of Bharti Devialong with two of her eldest son who he manages to convice. But he knows that he has a hurdle in front of him called Arjun. Arjun is the brother of those two conspirators. He always works for the wellness and rights of the villagers, every single villager loves him and they believes him as their friend. On the other hand an urban girl Nanda came to Ramnagar and falls in love with Aarjun. But her mother wants her to marry Rudra who eventually is the brother of Sonatan. Then after lots of struggle Arjun became victorious over the cruel thought of Sonaton and won her love.

description: A philosophical adventure biopic, 08.20 is a contemporary story of a young Moscow photographer in search of meaning, contribution and purpose. He rejects a safe, well-fed and quiet future, then struggles to transcend his austere childhood. His goal: transform the surrounding Russian bleakness into vivid color photographs. To develop his artistic sensibility, a method: destroy the rational, the educated mind. Take risks, shoot heroin, experiment with sex and techno. His artworks grow, the Universe has his back. He dodges bullets, runs from cops and dupes his parents. To mature as a pro, he moves to Paris, the city of photography. Where he clashes with consumerism, post-modernism and the art establishment. So he amplifies the reckless habits, approaches the revelation. Until his new French girlfriend sways him towards comfort, advertising projects, money, health and family. Good fortune? Or a fatal mistake? Can he have it all? Or has he left the path of self-realization? Spanning 3 decades, the film portrays the work and doubts of a photojournalist, as he confronts the ethics of war photography, dives into music press awash with drugs, then photographs extreme sports (climbing, cycling, aerobatics and sailing), searching for his artistic core, questioning the boundaries between an artist and a sell-out. Shot in Moscow, Ural, Paris, Berlin, the Atlantic Ocean and the Alps; out of sequence, scene by scene, it assembles a puzzle of debauchery and sadness, of pleasure and sacrifice, of free will and fate. A dialogue of cultures, in English, French and Russian. A visually-stunning love story, with an abrupt and ambiguous ending.

title: I Only Want You to Love Me
description: A man is interviewed by a sympathetic woman. His tale unfolds, of hard work that never pleases his parents, of a father who denigrates his efforts, of an indifferent mother. He builds them a house. Instead of offering their flat to him and his bride, they give the flat up, so he goes to Munich to work in construction, bringing his wife who is soon pregnant. They buy things on credit; he works overtime. He shows up with flowers and expensive gifts. When construction slows and he works less overtime, he cannot adjust his spending habits: he needs to be loved. Pressures mount. When he snaps, and violence ensues, who will be his victim?

title: D.N. Angel
description: Not-so-average teenager, Daisuke Niwa, has had an abnormal life. His mother and grandfather have trained him his whole life by setting up traps that can kill him if he doesn't figure them out.

title: Thumb N It
description: A shy withdrawn country lad is watching Global Citizens music video Broken Doll over and over and he becomes fixated on the girl starring in the video.

title: Gav-n
description: When a genetically engineered weapon escapes containment from a top secret lab in Northern California a dark chess match begins amongst the members of the "Recovery team."

title: Crash N Burn
description: A mild-mannered high school band teacher fills in for a flamboyant 80's hair band frontman in a 'Monsters of Rock' world tour.

title: Love N Success
description: Money changes everything.

title: Comics N Cocktails
description: The awkwardest duo around, from Awkward Conversations on Nerd Reactor, bring you Comics 'n Cocktails! Drinking booze and chatting about comic-books, superheroes, sci-fi, games, cult films, fantasy stories, magic, Star Wars, technology, Star Trek, cosplaying...and did we mention drinking booze? Anastasia 'Darth Boobs' Washington and Nathan 'Angry Baby' Lichtman sit down with nerdy guests and ask them the awkward questions you always wanted to... and did we mention there's drinking?

title: N of 1
description: An electronic parts salesman in Toronto with no medical training conceives an idea that could revolutionize medicine. A young woman living in the American South faced with an incurable disease takes him up on it, and the two set out on an international odyssey to realize the possibility of a cure.

title: Tricks 'n' Tracks
description: The series of magic, music, tricks and tips. With Paul Zenon , Sally Gray , resident robots Arbie, Adam and Eve, and Russ Stevens performing some dazzling illusions.

title: Hill 'n' Gully
description: Ten year old Sara Sapphire attacks a kid who taunts her in class, gets suspended for a week and can only return to school if her mother takes her to a psychiatrist to deal with her explosive temper. Dr. Moses discovers that the angry root in Sara grows even deeper in her mother, Carin Shiquita and her grandmother who suffers from agoraphobia. During her week of suspension, Sara Sapphire goes to work with Carin. There, photographer Caleb Foster, who is painfully shy, frequents the restaurant in which Carin works hoping to take her picture and ask her out on a date...not just any date, but his first date ever!

title: BL!N Magazine
description: BLIN Magazine, a member of the DEPO media group, is an information portal for "a new rhythm of life".

title: Wild 'N Out S6-S21
description: Watch as Nick Cannon and a new A-list celebrity lead a team of improv comedians each week as they compete against each other in the new show: Nick Cannon Presents Wild 'N Out.
