description: Based on the novel "Totônio Pacheco", written by João Alphonsus. At the time of the decadence of the great farms of Minas Gerais, Totônio is a symbol of the golden age of state farms: old and accustomed to having all his wills obeyed. However, after moving to his son's home because of his wife's death and the resulting loneliness, he realizes that he has lost his job as a boss and is struggling to regain his prestige by moving to a brothel.

title: O theios mou, o Ippokratis
description: Unable to change his brother's mind, who's decided to marry off his daughter to a wealthy compatriot, a progressive uncle sets his sights on helping his niece and her beau. Can Uncle Ippokratis save the day and let love shine through?

title: Confronto o Roteiro, Encontro o Amor
description: Bianca desperta no corpo da nora submissa dos Navarro. Decidida a mudar seu destino, enfrenta o marido frio e expõe a hipocrisia da irmã adotiva. O inesperado? Sua conexão com Vinícius — o tio influente que antes só impunha regras, agora fascinado por sua coragem. Enquanto Henrique tenta reparar seu erro, ela prova que uma vítima pode se tornar protagonista.

title: Nazm-o Nasr, Qowl-o Qazal
description: This concert was performed in September 2011 in Niavaran Cultural Center.

title: O Amuleto
description: Moçambique beach in Florianópolis, have a lot of unsolved murders cases. One day, Diana, Alex, Paulinho and Marcinha went to a party in the forest. In the next day, three teenagers are found death. Diana is the only survivor, but she doesn't remember what happen. The only thing that will help to solve the case is the videos recorded with their cell phones.

title: O Bobo
description: Set four years after the Portuguese revolution and the simultaneous loss of the Portuguese empire in Africa, the story concerns a director who sells guns to finance his play.

title: Harry O
description: After being shot in the line of duty, Harry Orwell was forced to retire from the San Diego Police Department. To supplement his police pension, Harry runs a private detective agency out of his beach house.

title: O, schastlivchik!
description: Recently, Slavik has started to question the meaning of life and he has not found a positive or satisfactory answer. On the brink of suicide and about to end it all, Slavik is offered a chance to alter the outcome of his life.

title: O Assalto
description: Lucas is in trouble, he has only a week to pay he's debts to Gomez. So he comes up with a plan and forms a team to steal a necklace that contains potential clues to a hidden treasure.

title: O aittitos
description: A childless Romani woman abducts the daughter of the prosecutor who imprisoned her. As she trains the child to do her evil bidding, the girl becomes a woman and soon finds herself accused of murder. Can a trainee solicitor clear her name?

title: Masha e o Urso: O Filme
description: Masha and the Bear: to the cinema. Young girl Masha, who can't sit still and the Bear who likes everything relaxed and in an orderly manner, have many new adventures together. Nice for young children as the adventures themselves take about 7 minutes each.

title: O Asymvivastos
description: Pavlos a young man full of dreams is questioning the Status quo and decides to quit medical school and become a street musician. He meets Apostoli Flou and the wandering begins.

title: O Casarão
description: Three moments in the life of a coffee farmer and his family, from the early 1900s to 1976.

title: O tsarlatanos
description: An immigrant in Germany works hard to be able to live his family in Greece. When eventually forced to return, he discovers that he hasn't a damn, because the bank has bankrupted. So returns hidden in a car-fridge and arrives frozen.

title: O manavis
description: A 'road-movie' documentary about Pindus Mountains and their people.

title: O trellopenintaris
description: A failed businessman who accepts to pose as a rich ship owner to break into high-end social circles, falls for a wealthy widow, unbeknownst to him that his official fiancée is not prepared to lose him. Will she bring him to his senses?

title: O parthenokynigos
description: Insurance agent has to make sure there is no payout on chastity policy .

title: O ouranokatevatos
description: Yearning to see his beloved family one last time to lend them a helping hand, a recently deceased paterfamilias asks dear God for a leave of absence; however, their scandalous misbehaviour is shocking. Can he help them get back on track?

title: O Pistoleiro
description: The film tells the story of three hired killers: one of them is a veteran of the profession; the other is naive, almost mentally weak; and the third is a circumstantial murderer who commits murder for revenge and is forced by a principal to take the path of crime.

title: Selling the OC S1-S4
description: Jason Oppenheim, owner of the Oppenheim Group, expands the company opening a second office in Newport Beach.

title: O Corpo
description: Xavier, a pharmacist, lives peacefully in bigamy with his two women, Carmen and Beatriz, but the harmony breaks down when they find he has another lover, Monique, a nightclub dancer.

headers.User-Agent: com.community.oneroom/50020118 (Linux; U; Android 9; en_US; 23078RKD5C; Build/PQ3A.190605.03081104; Cronet/135.0.7012.3)

title: Deen-O
description: When a few local kids discover a dormant military operation, magic comes alive and the adventure unfolds as they learn about and defend their new friend Deen-O

title: O emporakos
description: An honest medical student, who sells newspapers to make ends meet, falls in love with an affluent young woman with big, sad eyes. But, a shameless theft taints his immaculate reputation. Can an orphaned pedlar help him clear his name?

title: Quando o Tempo Sela o Amor
description: Um acordo desenrola a perseguição persistente de Kim Woo-jin por Lim Eun-ju. Dizem por aí que ele a ama até os ossos. Acontece que Eun-ju vivia à deriva após o término com seu antigo amor e aceitou o pedido de Woo-jin por impulso. Woo-jin abandona o sonho de ser médico e vira marido em casa, dedicando-se em segredo a desenvolver um medicamento para a alergia dela. Mas ela continua fria, só com Seo Min-ho no coração. Quando Seo Min-ho retorna, Woo-jin pede o divórcio.

title: O filos mou o Lefterakis
description: Thodorakis is a womanizer who lies to his wife about having a friend who lives in Patra in order to cover his dirty business. What happens when this fake friend appears in front of him and the night before he is ready to go with his mistress?

title: O Cavalariço Governa o Reino.
description: O herdeiro Roland Valen é forçado a se esconder após uma força misteriosa aniquilar sua família. Depois que a nobre Isabella o acolhe como cavalariço, ele passa dois anos ocultando as mortais habilidades de combate no polo que o fizeram temido em todo o reino. Mas, quando um implacável príncipe estrangeiro toma Isabella como alvo e ameaça a Casa Astra, Roland precisa sair das sombras e provar que o cavalariço que todos desprezavam é muito mais perigoso do que parece.

title: O Psyllos
description: "O Psyllos" (The Flea) is the title of a newspaper, published by a 12-year-old student, Elias, who lives in a small village on highland Olympia. His dream and its pursuit are thriftily but beautifully illustrated, along with the rural life of the '60s in Greece.

title: O fovos
description: Lei Bicheng uses the magic to bring Lv Guichen back to life. Xiao Zhou finds out the King's secret.

title: O Gado Deu o Troco
description: Leonardo fez de Marcela a rainha de Wall Street, mas foi empurrado de um telhado por ela e Breno no dia do próprio casamento. Ao abrir os olhos novamente, Leonardo se vê de volta à época da faculdade. Tendo essa nova chance, ele jura viver apenas para si, chega de ser o gado da Marcela. Ele até encontra alguém novo: a jovem herdeira da Família Holanda...

title: O Rebelde e o Estudioso
description: Maya Hayes é uma aluna nota dez com um objetivo: estudar muito, escapar do pai violento e nunca mais olhar para trás. Mas ao buscar refúgio em um estúdio de tatuagem após uma surra, ela esbarra no rebelde do Colégio Oakridge, Jude Sinclair. Logo, a aluna exemplar e o garoto rico com um passado sombrio viram colegas de classe. As madrugadas viram segredos compartilhados, e os insultos dão lugar à compreensão. Aos poucos, enxergam além de suas armaduras e descobrem algo verdadeiro. Juntos, fazem um pacto: libertar-se, lutar e destruir tudo o que tenta derrubá-los.

title: O Gringo
description: The story of Dejan Petkovic 'Rambo', a Serbian footballer who became a legend of Brazilian league and Flamengo in particular.

title: O apithanos
description: Thomas, the owner of an electrical appliances store, is having business problems due to his short-fuse temper and bad luck.

title: Tú o nadie
description: A young woman gets involved in a feud between two brothers.

title: O Sobrinho Dele é o Meu Pecado
description: Melanie Thorne é advogada de sucesso, divide escritório com o marido há dez anos e venceu o centésimo caso. George Dearborn volta do exterior para ser nomeado herdeiro da Dearborn Pharmaceuticals; é sobrinho do marido de Melanie. Quando se conhecem, a faísca é imediata e surge um amor intenso. Mas o universo, as famílias e a sociedade se voltam contra eles. Cederão às pressões ou ousarão acreditar que o mundo pertence a eles?

title: O Casarão
description: An old house withers away at the heart of a village ripped in half by a road where cars no longer stop. During the dictatorship, this building was the most progressive Catholic seminary in Portugal. António, the front door neighbor, was brought up and raised a family in its shadow. Ever since the Dominican priests left, he has been its most faithful caretaker - keeper of ghosts, memories, and hallways now emptied of life. Abandoned for years, the town's former epicenter now hopes for a new life.

title: O Secunda
description: One second it's all it takes for lives to unravel, either you loose everything you hold dear or you get a new chance.

title: O Abhagi
description: A poor family lived in a small village far from the city. Batasa is the only girl in that family. She's dream is to marry a Raj Kumar, but it doesn't happen. On the other hand, Batasas father was always worried about his daughter marriage.

headers.User-Agent: com.community.oneroom/50020118 (Linux; U; Android 9; en_US; 23078RKD5C; Build/PQ3A.190605.03081104; Cronet/135.0.7012.3)

title: O Descarte
description: Claudia (Gloria Menezes) is a wealthy widow, she found in Bruno (Ronnie Von) a new love. But one morning, receives an anonymous letter containing a serious threat.

title: O mestre e o Divino
description: Two filmmakers portray life in the village and in the mission of Sangradouro, Mato Grosso: Adalberto Heide, an eccentric German missionary, that soon after the contact with the Indians, in 1957, starts to film with his Super-8 camera; and Divino Tserewahu, a young Xavante filmmaker, that produces films for television and cinema festivals since the 90's. Shifting between complicity, competition, irony and affect, they give life to their historical records, revealing peculiar back-stages of indigenous catechizing in Brazil...

title: O Desejo
description: Widowed one year ago, Eleonora, a 33-year-old woman from Sao Paulo's upper bourgeoisie, lives alone, unsuited to her husband's absence, an intellectual frustrated and torn between the need for transcendence and a strong sexual compulsion. The life of the couple, although not happy, was intense. However, the presence of her a long-time friend Ana Maria, just arrived from Paris, a middle-class university student, is staying at his house. The two go to the site of Eleonora and she remembers her life with Marcelo and his death by drowning.

title: O Milionário
description: A sentimental comedy about toothpicks. A man makes and exchanges toothpicks for numerous products as he ignores money. He is called "The millionaire" and goes through the city, walking, meeting friends, Carlitos, the newspaper seller, and Celeste the lemon seller and living an innocent life, in contrast with the city, filled with traps.

title: O Pseftothodoros
description: Theodoros comes to Greece from abroad. They welcome him friends and relatives, wanting his fortune.

title: O LODI
description: A rich lady diagnosed of cancer, finds joy in a young man to kill her depressed state. But aside from her erupt cancer, something else wants her dead and very fast too.

title: Patrolman P
description: In 1971 the Knapp Commission, entrusted to expose corruption in the New York Police Department, faces a major problem. They have little physical evidence - their main source, Frank Serpico, won't wear a wire. They finally strike gold when a corrupt cop named William Phillips agrees to become their undercover agent, in exchange for immunity from a bribery charge. The evidence he eventually collects leads directly to the indictment of thirty New York cops. But the tables quickly turn when Phillips himself is convicted of a double-homicide. Three decades later and still in prison Phillips claims he's the victim of a massive police conspiracy.

title: Magdalena, kinaaliwan sa Miss Q&A
description:
What doesn't kill you makes you stronger, at sa bawat pagsubok ay mas tumatatag ang character. Mula sa Bahay ni Kuya, balik-“Showtime” na si Cianne Dominguez, hawak muli ang mikropono, slay kung slay sa pagpe-perform sa entablado. Group hug para kay Cianne!

Kung ang mood mo ay hindi kagandahan, mga beki ay may hatid kaming bonggang katatawanan. Sa talas ng isip at husay sa talakan, ang Miss Q&A candidates na ang bahalang magpagaan ng 'yong pakiramdam.

Sina Magdalena Fox, Maria Divina Bulawan Gil, at Yems Deligario Espinola, nagpalitan ng mga hirit. Si Magdalena, kinaaliwan sa kanyang pagpapakatotoo at transformation, at sa aktingan niya with Vhong Navarro.

Huwag hayaang malunod sa kalungkutan, sumabay sa alon ng saya at tawanan. Mula sa Dagat-Dagatan, Navotas, ang Madlang Players ay nakipagsapalaran, at baka sa Laro Laro Pick ay makabingwit pa ng malaking papremyo at kasiyahan.

Sa Act-Song round, ang script nila ni Darren Espanto, hindi kinaya ni Jackie Gonzaga sa kanilang aktingan. From one role to another, si Darren 'social distancing' pa rin ang gusto. Ayaw "madamay" kay hindi na lang daw muna siya magmo-move closer kay Cianne.

Sa jackpot round, si Aichelle ang sumabak sa larong may halong kaba. Ang Li-Pot offer na P25,000, tinanggap niya para siguradong may maihahanda sa darating na Pasko para sa pamilya. May panghihinayang nga lang na naramdaman si Aichelle dahil alam pala niya ang sagot sa P150,000 na POT question.

title: Miss Q&A Havana
description:
Kasama natin for today's video ang bandang The Red Strings, na very inspired sa paggawa ng nakaka-good vibes na musika. Sa mga taong naghahanap ng organic encounter, at para sa lahat, ang kanta nilang "Nasa Ulap."

Matatapos na ang June, pero hindi ang wit at tawanan sa "Miss Q and A." Sina Kishan Garcia ng Makati, Rhain Bayonon ng Manila, at Havana Alawi ng Quezon City ang nagPAKsiklabn sa 'chukchakan' today.

Para kay Kishan, her tattoos are part of her charm at kagandahan. Eh, kung may bagay na tattoo kay Havana, ano kaya ito? May naisip na si Vice Ganda! Pwedeng kulayan daw ng blue si Havana tapos ‘avatar’ ang kalalabasan. 'Amats' nga ni Meme ang beki na may kakaibang 'hugis' ang tainga, at ang boses ay tunog galing ibang planeta. Biro ni Meme, parang nagtatawag ng alien si Havana.

With grace and substance ang talakan nina Kishan at Rhaine sa Wit Lang. Si Kishan, nabunot ang tanong na, "Ilang oras ang dapat itulog ng jowa mong napagod na sayo?" Sagot niya, hindi dapat makatulog sa kaiisip sa kan'ya ang ex-jowa.

Mga kwentong nakakatuwa at may hati na inspirasyon at pag-asa ang pasalubong ng mga taga-Malanday, Marikina sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Nakakuwentuhan nina Vice Ganda, Kim Chiu at Amy Perez ang isang tricycle driver, na pakiramdam ay wala ng pag-asa ang mga pangarap niya. Kaya ang payo nila, maniwala! Sabi nga ni Kim, "The world is big and so are your dreams."

Big naman ang aktingan sa inaabangan na 'You Gotta Lyric' round. Si Teddy Corpuz, tiklop sa mga lalaking malaki ang katawan. Si Jackie Gonzaga, tiklop naman sa paalala ni Ion Perez na taken na siya.

It must be the curly hair na naghatid ng swerte kay Bert, na sinugalan ang P100,000 POT money. Ano nga ba ang halamang pinakamabilis tumubo ayon sa Guinness World Records?

title: Miss Q&A
description:
Pak na pak ang mga kandidatang tumalak sa Miss Q and A Weekly Finals. Dahil sa malakas na cheer ng Madang People, napa-"and I thank you" sina Elthon Bequio, Trixie Gomez, Gabriela Duevall, Queen Sam Ri, Freda, at Kathryn Fernando Poe, Jr.

Ang mga accla, nagbardagulan at bumuo ng kani-kanilang grupo. Pero at the end of the competition, nangingibabaw pa rin sa kanila ang nahanap na bagong sisterhood... at may nahanap din na pag-ibig? Si Gabriela, na-love at first sight sa 'poganda' na si Queen Sam Ri. At totoo ba ang balita na may isang lasing na kandidata?!

Ang Top 4 na sina Sam Ri, Elthon, Freda, at Gabriela ang umabante sa Wit Lang round. At mula sa apat, dalawa lang ang nag-face off sa Beklamation. It's Sam Ri versus Elthon sa katanungan na, "Sa panahon ngayon anong mas nakakatakot, katangahan o kasamaan?"

Talak ni Sam Ri, mas nakakatakot ang katangahan dahil ito ang dahilan kung bakit marami ang nabibiktima ng fake news. "May mga taong matatalino pero nagtatanga-tangahan kaya nadadakip sila at napapaniwala ng mali," sabi ni Sam Ri.

Mula NCR, sumugod sa Laro Laro Pick game arena ang Madlang Players na nangtatrabaho sa printing shops. May isang player ba na magpapa-tarpaulin ng "congrats" dahil na-hit ang jackpot?

Ay, nakaka-in love talaga! Nakisali pa sweet-sweet-an sina Darren Espanto at Jackie Gonzaga, na pinakilig ang Madlang People sa kanilang 'rainy moment' na eksena!

Pagkatapos ng It's Giving, You Gotta Lyric, at Laro Laro Pick rounds, ang joy ay kumapit kay player Joy.

title: Miss Q&A candidate, may kakaibang dictionary!
description:
Mula sa iconic na “Jumbo Hotdog” at “Sana Mama” na minsang nagpaindak sa buong nation, nagbabalik to flex their muscles and new single ang grupong Masculados. Grateful ang grupo na makabalik at mabigyan ng pagkakataong ipagpatuloy ang kanilang musika.

Hindi lang ganda ang puhunan, dapat may wit na panlaban. Dahil bawat tanong, kailangang may sagot na papalakpakan ng buong bayan. Kaya naghanda ng matitinding linyahan ang mga Miss Q and A candidates na nagharapan.

Ready magbigay ng tutorial sa ganda at talino ang online tutor na si Precious Alden Ganaden, habang mula pageant coaching ay siya naman ngayon ang sasabak sa sariling laban, si MJ Apin Salada. Naaliw naman ang Madlang People, pati na si Vice Ganda, sa kakaibang dictionary ni Ivanach.

Sa second round na Wit Lang, sina MJ at Ivanach ang nagharap. Sinubok si Ivanach sa tanong na, “Kung lechon ka, mao-offend ka ba kung balat lang ang habol sa ’yo samantalang full package ka naman?” Si MJ naman, napaisip kunngmagtatampo ba ang king cobra kung hindi siya ang king of the jungle.

Ayusin ang display at siguraduhing kumpleto ang stocks at siguruhing available ang swerte. Mula sa pag-aasikaso ng mga produktong mabenta, saglit munang iniwan ng mga merchandisers mula NCR ang kanilang puwesto para subukang i-checkout ang POT money sa “Laro Laro Pick."

Kinilala ng hosts si player Frank, ang loving hubby and addy na baon sa utang. Kaya naman si Tyang Amy Perez, to the rescue bitbit ang payo niyang wais. Love life naman ang usapan nang kanilang lapitan si pplayer Yong, na dinamayan ng hosts matapos malamang hiwalay na sila ng kanyang girlfriend.

Kay Frank talaga napunta ang swerte dahil siya ang umabot sa Jackpot Round! Pero imbes na isugal ang lahat para sa ₱450,000 POT, pinili niyang tanggapin ang ₱35,000 Li-Pot offer para may siguradong maipambayad sa kanyang maraming utang.

title: Ahtisa, pinuri ang Miss Q&A segment
description:
Major throwback feels ang hatid ni New Zealand singer-songwriter na si Bic Runga sa “It’s Showtime” nang kantahin niya ang kanyang hit na “Sway," na bahagi na ng playlist ng maraming Pinoy, lalo na noong ’90s at early 2000s.

Huwag ubusin ang wit, dapat laging may reserba lalo na kung sa 'Miss Q and A' ka eeksena. Pak na pak na palakpakan ang sumalubong kina Mariposa Jem Lacsina, Affarah Deur, at Curevedilol Filipinas Galore as they walked the runway and left the crowd wanting more.

Dahil kakaiba mga pangalan ng mga kandidata, na-curious si Vice Ganda at inalam ang kuwento sa likod ng mga ito. Kung ang "It's Showtime" family naman ang papipiliin, ano ng gusto nilang maging 'beki' name? Back to the pageant, hindi tumalab ang full pack makeup ni Curevedilol sa pabilisan sa pagpindot at pagsagot. Siya ang unang umuwing lotlot. Sina Mariposa at Affarah naman ang nag-face off sa Wit Lang.

Mga bituin at diskarte ang kanilang gamay para sumakses sa buhay. Swerte ay maningning, kaya POT money ang goal sungkitin ng madlang players mula Tala, Caloocan na sumabak sa Laro Laro Pick.

Agaw-eksena ang galawan ni player Rian. Kung twerking lang naman kasi ang labanan, si Jackie Gonzaga ay wit niya uurungan. Na-shookt ang everybody, lalo na si Vice Ganda, sa wild moves ni Rian sa dance floor. Para bang makabagong bunot ang peg!

Kinaaliwan naman ni Meme Vice si Gara, isa labandera, dahil super natural lang ng cuteness at charisma nito. Pero naging emotional si Gara nang mapag-usapan ang kanyang asawa. Na-touch si Meme sa kuwento, kaya may pakimkim na agad itong abuinaldo bago pa man dumating ang Pasko.

Kay Gara nga kumapit ang swerte. Sa jackpot round, siya ang umabante! Nadoble pa ang kanyang aguinaldo dahil umuwi siyang may tatlumpung libong piso, matapos tanggapin ang Li-Pot offer.

title: MC at Lassy, 'NAGSABUNUTAN' sa Miss Q&A
description:
Sa "It's Showtime" entablado they're always getting fiercer and fiercer with their new single "Spider." Here comes DNA, ready to slay! Ang singing trio nina Tasha, Julia at Ezri, nagpasikat sa harap ng Madlang People.

Ang pag-ibig, wala 'yan sa edad o kasarian. Kapag tumibok ang puso, huwag nang itago. Ipagsigawan ang damdamin! Ang feelings, aminin! Parang mga Miss Q and A candidates na hindi nagpapigil sa self-expression at pagtalak para marinig ng buong nation.

Mega slay sa pagrampa at talakan na havey ang queens na sina Francyne Astronomia, Kiana Ortega, at Dha-Dha Aringo.

Si Francyne na softie girlie, idol si Overtime Diva, Miss Trina. As a student, hate na hate niya 'yung mga kagrupo na palaging late. Si candidate 3, Dha-Dha, ipinakilala ang kanyang girlfriend of 9 years na si RR.

Sina Dha-Dha at Kiana ang umabante sa Wit Lang kung saan nasubok ang kanilang talino at creativity sa mga tanong na mapaglaro't nakakalito. Mas nagustuhan nina hurados Max Collins, Michael Sager, at Nicole Cordoves ang talak ni Kiana, kaya siya ang kinoronahan bilang Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era of the day.

Humataw nang wagas at napasigaw nang malakas ang Madlang Players mula San Jose, Navotas. Sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, malakas din ba ang swerte nila?

Malakas talaga ang chemistry ng DaCkie! Madlang People ay kinilig sa eksena nina Darren Espanto at Jackie Gonzaga. May pananagutan na?! Si Sergio (Vhong Navarro), nami-miss si Memerimar (Vice Ganda). Sobrang longing naman 'yan! Ang ating leading man, naghanap ng bagong Memerimar—walang iba kundi si Ryan Bang!

Sina Enteng at Mayang, parehong naka-survive sa You Gotta Lyric. Pero sa 'Laro Laro Pick,' one point lang ang kinailangan ni Mayang para umabante sa jackpot round kung saan nagkaroon siya ng pagkakataon na manalo ng P150,000.

title: Miss Q&A Rexy, UMIYAK nang matalo
description:
Ang naghatid ng feels na tunay, ang 'love team' na OA magpangiti, sina ex-"PBB Collab" housemates Dustin Yu at Bianca De Vera a.k.a. DustBia. Sa pagsayaw pa lang ng "Oohh Lala Baby," ang hiyawan ng fans parang umabot na sa ibang galaxy.

Ipinamalas naman ng T-MATES ang husay ng Pinoy sa pagsasayaw, na kanila ring ibinandera sa World of Dance Dance Summit 2026 kung saan napabilang sila sa Top 6 finalists.

Buong universe ang kayang sakupin ng mga Miss Q and A candidates with their beauty and wit. Parang stars na kumikinang sina ML Tucay ng Pangasinan, Rexy Morales ng Nueva Ecija, at Dessy Baldomero ng Marikina as they slay sa pagrampa.

Si ML, beterenang kontesera na 'idol' ng mga kapwa niya kandidata. Volleyball naman ang hilig ni Dessy, ang 6-footer beauty. 'Bunot' naman ni Vice Ganda si Rexy, na super cute sa kanyang paningin. Pero ang cuteness niya, hindi umubra sa Tumpak Ganern round ung saan ‘lotlot’ ang kanyang inabot. Aray! Si Rexy, napa-cry!

Hindi naman luhaan sina hurado Marina Summers, Brent Manalo, at Nicole Cordoves dahil pak na pak ang 'chukchak' ng dalawang kandidatang tumalak sa Wit Lang round. Saksakan ng galing ang answer ni ML, kaya for today's video, sa kanya ang korona bilang Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era.

Shining bright ang good vibes sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, kasama ang mga estudyanteng bright din ang future. Sila ang mga Dean's Lister at President Lister's players!

Nakipagkuwentuhan ang hosts kay Lauren, na nag-share kung paano napapanatiling masaya ang buhay-estudyante sa kabila ng pressure. Parang literal na 'pressured' naman si Arnel, na pinaikot-ikot nina Vice Ganda, Amy Perez, at Kim Chiu habang ini-interview.

Si Jackie Gonzaga, na-pressure naman sa dalawang manliligaw niya. Para bang 'the plot thickens' sa love triangel nila ni Brent Manalo at Darren Espanto sa Act-Song!

Pasok sa listahan ng jackpot players si Jelo, na bet maging isang newsroom staff someday. Heto ang latest news: si Jelo, natagpuang matapang at tinanggihan ang P35,000 Li-Pot offer kapalit ng pagkakataon na masagot ang P250,000 POT question.

title: Miss Q&A: Lucia, pagod nang magpanggap sa male pageants?
description:
Big pasabog ang naging announcement ni Bianca Gonzalez sa August 14 episode ng "It's Showtime." Kasama ang "Pinoy Big Brother" co-hosts na sina Gabbi Garcia at Kim Chiu, ibinalita ni Bianca ang muling pagbubukas ng Bahay ni Kuya sa pinakabagong "PBB Collab 3.0." 

To mark this new and exciting "PBB" era, nakisaya ang ilan sa mga ex-housemates. From Bahay Ni Kuya to the "It's Showtime" stage, muling nagsama-sama sa isang song and dance prod number sina “PBB Collab” ex-housemates AC Bonifacio, Klarisse De Guzman, Will Ashley, at Mika Salamanca, with Kabataang Pinoy Lella Ford, Joaquin Arce, Marco Masa, at Ashley Sarmiento na mula naman sa "PBB Collab 2.0."

Sa queendom ng talakan, isa lang ang pwedeng umangat. Pero sa araw na 'to, tatlong reyna ang nagharap-harap. Ibinuhos nina Sta. Lucia Joaquin Bordado, Miukie, at CK Alcaraz Zarfl ang wit at talak na di paaawat para korona ay sa kanila tumapat. 

Nakaka-reyna rin ang mga kuwento at inspirasyon na ibinahagi nila. Si Candidate 1, stop na sa pagpapanggap, kay from male pageants, Miss Q&A naman ang sinubukan upang maipakita ang totoong sarili. 

School teacher at dating principal naman si Candidate 2. Pero ano nga ba ang mga diskriminasyon na hinarap niya sa karera? At si Candidate 3, naghahanap ng kalinga ng ama. Nanawagan siya sa amang German, hoping na magkita sila soon sa unang pagkakataon.
Sina Miukie at CK ang nag-face off sa Wit Lang round. First time naman ni Bianca Gonzalez na umupo bilang hurado. 

Ang mga muscles nila ay kaflex-flex! Mag-work out din kaya ang swerte para sa mga gym instructors ng Metro Manila.

Si player Nad ang patunay na palaging may second chance ang taong determinadong mapaganda ang buhay. Ang dating number one sa inuman, gym na ang paboritong tambayan. 

Katulad sa real life, nabigyan din si Nad ng second chance sa laro. Matapos ma-eliminate ang lahat ngg players, bumunot ng isang sasalang sa jackpot round, at pangalan ni Nad ang nabunot.

title: Raine SHOOKT sa naging kapalaran sa Miss Q&A
description:
May mensahe ka ba sa ex mong biglang nag-walkout sa buhay mo? Kung may gustong o-shoutout, aba’y huwag nang mahiya. Katulad ng "It's Showtime" hosts na matapang na humugot tungkol sa kanilang mga TOTGA, at mga ex na minsan silang pinaluha.

Kung si Brent Manalo ay may shoutout sa "dating Big Winner" ng buhay niya, si Ryan Bang naman ay may mensahe sa babaeng naghatid ng pag-ibig na hindi natuloy sa dambana. At si Kim Chiu, hindi raw pinagsisihan si ex pero hindi na niya ito babalikan dahil may mga bagay na dapat ala-ala na lang.

Walang awat din sa pagtalak ang mga Miss Q and A Talaki-Talks of the week na sina Xantie, Raine Garcia, Stacey Doroteo, Adam Lambert, at Dhey Pascual Abital.

Effective ang reminder ni Vice Ganda sa mga accla na maging mas maliksi at witty. Bawal dito ang mababa ang energy. Kaya sunod-sunod ang kanilang pagsagot sa Tumpak Ganern round hanggang si Stacey ang naiwan at dumiretso na sa uwian. Samantala, ang apat ay naglaban-laban sa Wit Lang kung saan umangat sina Raine at Xantie.

Ang Beklamation question of the day, "Kung ikaw ang original jowa, anong gagawin mo sa keridang mas matapang pa umasta kaysa sa'yo?"

Pleasant ang energy kaya pleasant din ang pagpasok ng swerte para sa mga taga-Pleasant Hills, Mandaluyong City na na humataw ay nag-enjoy sa Laro Laro Pick.

Sa moves niyang bigay-todo, kuhang-kuha ni Nanay Inday ang atensyon mo. Ang kuwentuhan, kung saan na napunta. How true na 'nepo mommy' si Inday at low-key rich siya? Tahimik lang din sa 'gedli' si player Badjong pero kapag tinitigan, ay, pang leading man!

Looking for pleasant personality? Meron n'yan si Chel, ang masipag na manikurista na very happy sa love life with her lesbian partner, Shella. Dahil inspired, may extra tapang si Chel na sugalan ang POT question na katumbas na ng P350,000.

Bigo si Chel na maibigay ang tamang sagot. Pero, sabi nga ni Vice Ganda, mahal na mahal niya ang mga kapwa niya members ng LGBT community. Gusto niyang pasayahin sina Chel at Shella, kaya may regalo siyang P20,000 sa couple.

title: Jogos Bons Q Vc Não Conhece - Colônia Contra Ataca
Miss Q&A candidate, dumami ang 'boyfriend' sa studio
description:
Sabi nga nila, after the rain there's a rainbow na naghihintay. Pero hindi pa man natatapos ang buhos ng ulan, kinulayan na ni Heath Jornales ang ating mga buhay sa karisma niyang taglay. Isang kilig harana at magandang balita ang hatid ng "PBB Collab 2.0" Kapuso 2nd Big Placer.

Nagningning ang tatlong kandidata na nagpatalasan ng wit sa Miss Q and A segment. Ready to dominate the 'queendom' of talak sina Xantie, Kendra, at Lancy Empleo. 

Rain or shine, tuloy rin ang puksaan at kulitan ng paborito nating trio sa FUNanghalian, sina Vhong Navarro, Vice Ganda, at Jhong Hilario. Gets na ni Meme Vice ang galawan ng mga kaibigan, kaya nang mapag-usapan ang mga ibong 'parrot,' si Meme na mismo ang bumitaw ng punchline at tinawag ang sarili bilang 'panot.' 

Samantala, sa Wit Lang round ang punta nina Xantie at Lancy kung saan hinarap nila ang magkaibang pageant questions. Bahagyang kinabahan ang mga kandidata, but the effort is appreciated. Besides, nagbigay ng advice si hurado Nicole Cordoves for their improvement. 

Hindi lang candidates ang nag-attempt na sungkitin ang puso ng judges, dahil maging si Ryan Bang ay give na give sa mga jokes as his way to the heart of hurado Max Collins. Kaya para makuha ang loob ng mga kaibigan ni Max, nagpa-impress na rin ang cutie Koreano pati sa ibang hurado.

Kung malamig ang panahon, mainit naman na pinaglabanan sa Laro Laro Pick game arena ang POT money na P250,000. Nakakuwentuhan ng hosts si player Aubrey, isang cashier na nagbahagi ng karanasan sa mga scammer. Malakas naman ang dating ni player Darren, kaya si Jackie Gonzaga biglang longing. 

Sinuwerte nang todo si Maricel, na nabunot ang pangalan para sa jackpot round matapos ma-eliminate ang lahat ng players. Naging maingat si Maricel sa pagpili, at naging wais hanggang sa huli.

title: Meme Vice, naguluhan sa pagkatao ni Miss Q&A Rexy
description:
Ang naghatid ng feels na tunay, ang 'love team' na OA magpangiti, sina ex-"PBB Collab" housemates Dustin Yu at Bianca De Vera a.k.a. DustBia. Sa pagsayaw pa lang ng "Oohh Lala Baby," ang hiyawan ng fans parang umabot na sa ibang galaxy.

Ipinamalas naman ng T-MATES ang husay ng Pinoy sa pagsasayaw, na kanila ring ibinandera sa World of Dance Dance Summit 2026 kung saan napabilang sila sa Top 6 finalists.

Buong universe ang kayang sakupin ng mga Miss Q and A candidates with their beauty and wit. Parang stars na kumikinang sina ML Tucay ng Pangasinan, Rexy Morales ng Nueva Ecija, at Dessy Baldomero ng Marikina as they slay sa pagrampa.

Si ML, beterenang kontesera na 'idol' ng mga kapwa niya kandidata. Volleyball naman ang hilig ni Dessy, ang 6-footer beauty. 'Bunot' naman ni Vice Ganda si Rexy, na super cute sa kanyang paningin. Pero ang cuteness niya, hindi umubra sa Tumpak Ganern round ung saan ‘lotlot’ ang kanyang inabot. Aray! Si Rexy, napa-cry!

Hindi naman luhaan sina hurado Marina Summers, Brent Manalo, at Nicole Cordoves dahil pak na pak ang 'chukchak' ng dalawang kandidatang tumalak sa Wit Lang round. Saksakan ng galing ang answer ni ML, kaya for today's video, sa kanya ang korona bilang Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era.

Shining bright ang good vibes sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, kasama ang mga estudyanteng bright din ang future. Sila ang mga Dean's Lister at President Lister's players!

Nakipagkuwentuhan ang hosts kay Lauren, na nag-share kung paano napapanatiling masaya ang buhay-estudyante sa kabila ng pressure. Parang literal na 'pressured' naman si Arnel, na pinaikot-ikot nina Vice Ganda, Amy Perez, at Kim Chiu habang ini-interview.

Si Jackie Gonzaga, na-pressure naman sa dalawang manliligaw niya. Para bang 'the plot thickens' sa love triangel nila ni Brent Manalo at Darren Espanto sa Act-Song!

Pasok sa listahan ng jackpot players si Jelo, na bet maging isang newsroom staff someday. Heto ang latest news: si Jelo, natagpuang matapang at tinanggihan ang P35,000 Li-Pot offer kapalit ng pagkakataon na masagot ang P250,000 POT question.

title: Nutridamus! Vice natawa sa mga sagot sa Miss Q&A
description:
Oooh lala-van na lavan ang pitik ng bewang nina Baby Dolls Arianne, Chloe, Johaira, Juby, Jelai, Eriel, and Ina. To welcome their era as an official P-Pop group at kauna-unahang Hype Group ng bayan, ginanap ang Baby Dolls Day.

Present ang mga social media personalities, Kapamilya at Kapuso "PBB" ex-housemates, beauty queens, P-Pop groups, "Tawag Ng Tanghalan" alumni, "Showtime Online U" hosts, at All-Star Games Basketball at Volleyball Team para makigiling.

Pagkatapos ng Baby Dolls Day celebration, bumida naman ang beki na may talak para sa buong nation. Meet CY ng Quezon City, Fema Braganza ng Pangasinan, at BRIGIT ng Laguna, ang mga talakera na sumubok masungkit ang korona sa Miss Q and A.

Minsan ang talak, may pagka-harsh, parang comment ni Ogie Alcasid, na hindi inurungan sa puksaan si Vhong Navarro. Kaya ang ilong ni Vhong, napuruhan sa laitan!

Naloka naman ang Madlang People sa sagot ng mga kandidata sa unang tanong sa Tumpak Ganern tungkol sa karakter sa Noli Me Tangere na sinasabing ama ni Maria Clara. Ang sagot ni BRIGIT, "Nutridamus!" Kaya biro ni Vice Ganda, kapatid ba 'yan ni Nutri Bun?

Sina Fema at CY ang umabante sa next round ng chukchakan, ang Wit Lang. Pagkatapos ng talakan, ang very 'pulchritudinous', sabi ni Brent Manalo, na si CY ang kinoronahan bilang Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era of the day.

Pumadyak ang swerte at good vibes para sa mga pedicab driver na sumalang sa Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Nakaka-touch ang pagiging solid Showtimer ni Tatay Doms, na may iniabot pang liham ng pasasalamat para kay Vice Ganda at sa buong "It's Showtime" family. Pero, si Kim Chiu, nagtampo, dahil wala ang pangalan niya sa sulat na ito.

Pagkatapos ng aktingan, iisa lang ang naka-survive sa laro! Ito ay si Mavin, na kahit mahirap man ang buhay ay nananatiling masayahin. Kapang P300k ang napasakanya, babawi siya sa magulang niya. Pero sapat nang pambawi ang P40,000 na Li-Pot offer kaya dito na siya sa siguradong uuwi siyang panalo.

title: EMOTIONAL INTELLIGENT, nangakong babalik sa Miss Q&A
description:
Mga pusong dati’y takot magpakatotoo, ngayon ay rumarampa nang taas-noo. Huwag nang matakot at mangamba, mga accla! Be proud at huwag magtago sa dilim! Slay, mga bading!

Ngayong Pride Month, officially nag-come-BEK na ang paboritong talakan segment ng Madlang People at sangkabadingan. Pinangunahan ni Vice Ganda ang pagbubukas ng pinakabagong season ng "Miss Q and A" sa isang makulay na production number with the proud gay members of the LGBT community at si Anne Patricia Lorenzo, ang may-ari ng korona sa previous season na "Miss Q and A: Kween of the Multibeks."

Ang unang batch ng contestants na sumalang sa talakan ay ang ex-campus journalist na si Miss Jawo, ang ‘lutang’ call center agent na si Princess Elizabeth, at Erin Rio na isang call center agent din. Sa Round 1, nag-unahan ang tatlong beki na sagutin ang tanong gamit ang dalawang phrases. Ang first two contestants to earn a point lang ang aabante sa next round. 'Ligwak' si Princess. Pero kahit nagkatotoo ang pabirong prediction ni Meme Vice na hindi ito mananalo, positibo pa rin ang pananaw ni Princess sa kanyang 'Talak ng Lotlot' farewell speech.

Sa Round 2, bumunot ang natitirang contestantsng tig-isang tanong. Mas pinusuan nina Karylle, Ralph de Leon, at Nicole Cordoves ang sagot ni Miss Jawo judges sa araw na 'to.

Best in kulitan ang mga taga-Bignay, Valenzuela! Good vibes ang bigay nila sa Laro laro Pick game arena. Hindi pwedeng trip-trip lang ang performance sa mga games! Dapat galingan para sa chance na makapaglaro sa jackpot round.

Si Edzel ang umabante sa final game. Pero bakit si Ogie Alcasid ang teary-eyed nang mapag-usapan ang asawang si Regine Velasquez? At tulad ni Ogie, iiyak din ba si Edzel sa kanyang mapipili?

title: Brasil S/A
description: Brazilian Dream is fruit of reflection on Brazil today. We Brazilians are used to seeing the country as peripheral, subaltern, poor and third-world. But in recent years Brazil has experienced rampant transformation that has reconfigured its archaic social structure. Yet this difficult and paradoxical modernization runs up against problems that seem to be historically determined. In the film we ask: what images can capture this new country? And we chance a few answers, starting with the delirious fable-spinning of a nation drunk on its own progress. These are images and sounds that echo and, at the same time, collide with the grand founding narratives of the national mindset. Through these images we enter into conflict with the messianic vocation of a Brazil eternally pre-destined to be the country of the future. Bodies, machines and landscapes move and shudder. Until the final eclipse.

title: Resurrecting McGinn(s)

His wife Anastasie suggests they throw a party on what would've been Aidan's fiftieth birthday. title: Gonka s presledovaniem

title: Mittal V/S Mittal
description: Girls have dreams - dreams of a fairytale romance, of prince charming sweeping them off their feet, a dream wedding and living happily ever-after. Mitali, a successful model, also had dreams... Then one day she met Karan, the Mittal scion, the heir to one of the richest families in the country. Mitali 's simple, middle-class upbringing is in complete contrast to Karan's super-brat lifestyle. But Karan was smitten by Mitali. Accustomed to getting what he wants in life, Karan landed up at Mitali's home with his parents with a marriage proposal. Delighted at their daughter's luck, Mitali's family approved of the match. And Mitali entered Karan's home and life as his newly-wedded bride. It was not long before Mitali's dreams turned into her worst nightmare. Her mother-in-law detested her and created misunderstandings between Karan and her. Karan turned out to be a puppet in his mother's hands and her father-in-law is a helpless, mute spectator. Karan has a certain pattern of dealing with women and wanted to subdue Mitali's independent streak. He who appeared to be a loving husband was in fact a violent monster at night within the privacy of their bedroom.Unable to bear the humiliation and pain after she resisted his advances and is raped by him,Mitali decided to take charge of her life. She decided to fight back.Mitali walked out of her in-laws home, hired a lawyer and filed a case against her husband. Karan retaliated by hiring the best lawyer money can buy to fight on his behalf. Mittal Vs Mittal is about to he heard in court. It is a case on file that fights for the rights of women like Mitali who are subjugated to domestic violence and inhuman treatment at the hands of husband and in-laws. It is a case that will empower women to fight for their pride, respect and their very right to live with dignity. It is Mitali Mittal versus Karan Mittal...

title: Daily T
description:
Thomas J Elliott is a master filmmaker who has worked all over the world, creating multi award winning projects for some of the world's leading global brands, from Coca-Cola to Microsoft, Manulife, global advertising agencies and anywhere and everywhere in between.

Beyond his work in content and commercials, he has directed documentaries, television series and more recently he has branched off into feature films and streaming content.

He is the author of five award-winning, best-selling books on visual content and visual storytelling.

In addition to this he is a regular contributor to leading educational workshops and events all over the world, from massive events like VidCon to private workshops for universities, think tanks and global brands and agencies.

In this first of its kind series created exclusively for social media platform LinkedIn, Thomas shares his thoughts on crafting and creating films and visual content as well as a deep dive into the directing process that covers everything from selecting the right material, to working with actors and crew, on set process and getting your work completed and out there.

The series provides a unique insight into an established working director, his process, the reality of working with brands, agencies, production companies, actors and production partners.

It shows the audience real world examples they can use in their work immediately to improve the quality of their work and their output.

Episodes are released weekly Monday to Friday on LinkedIn and across other channels.

title: masakra w
description:
Amerykański western w wersji z polskim lektorem - Masakra w Dragoon Wells.

Oficer kawalerii jako jedyny ocalał z ataku Indian. Wraz z wozem pełnym więźniów i skazańców, przemierza terytorium wrogo nastawionych Indian.

Masakra w Dragoon Wells (1957)
Reżyser: Harold D. Schuster
Scenarzyści: Warren Douglas, Oliver Drake
W rolach głównych: Barry Sullivan, Dennis O'Keefe, Mona Freeman
Gatunek: western
Kraj: USA
Język: angielski
Data premiery: 28 lutego 1958 r. (RFN)
Miejsca kręcenia: Kanab, Utah, USA

Fabuła:
Oficer kawalerii, jedyny ocalały z ataku Indian, wraz z wagonem więźniów przemierza wrogie tereny indiańskie.

Recenzje:
"„Nie jestem obiektywny, bo mam z tym filmem osobiste wspomnienia. Jako nastolatek lubiłem kolorowe westerny z popularnymi aktorami. Dziś wolę czarno-białe klasyki. Latem 1956 roku przypadkiem trafiłem na plan zdjęciowy tego filmu w Utah. Widziałem, jak kręcono kilka scen z O'Keefe’em i Cabotem. Później obejrzałem film w kinie i zaskoczyło mnie, że fabuła jest bardziej złożona niż w typowych westernach z lat 50. Nie ma tu jednego bohatera – to historia wielu postaci. Polecam każdemu, kto lubi filmy z dobrze napisanymi postaciami i solidną realizacją. Szkoda, że trudno znaleźć ten film na DVD.”
Autor: hitt_dave na IMDb.com
 

„To nie jest prosty western. Kapitan kawalerii i więźniowie muszą współpracować, by przetrwać na terenie Indian. Aktorstwo stoi na wysokim poziomie, reżyseria jest solidna, a muzyka buduje napięcie. Film ogląda się z prawdziwą przyjemnością.”
Autor: bux na IMDb.com

title: The Song of the Soul
description: Jerry Wendover, disfigured since childhood after his act of heroism in saving a little girl from a fire scarred his face, secludes himself in an old house in the Backwater district of Florida. One night he finds Barbara Seaforth, a young blind girl, lost in the swamps and takes her home. The two unfortunates fall in love, marry, and have a child. One day, a visiting doctor tells Jerry that Barbara's sight can be restored. The operation is performed successfully, but the doctor warns his patient to shield her eyes from the light or risk reversal of the surgery. Barbara, realizing her husband's dread of exposing his disfigurement to her, looks at her child and then permanently blinds herself by staring into the light, thus sacrificing her sight for the love of her husband.

title: Y
description: 'Y' is a Marathi thriller explored through hyperlinked narrative. The film revolves around four parallel yet interwoven stories coinciding at times.

title: Mujeres y hombres y viceversa
description: Program which aims to help participants to find love.

title: Psique y sexo
description: A movie in four parts. A frustrated woman finds love with a painter. A woman tries to seduce her subordinate when she takes him to her apartment. A woman who killed her husband falls in love with the gravedigger. The sexual awakening of two teenagers and the reaction of their parents.

title: Fuerte y afortunada
description: Fuerte y afortunada

title: Mosquita y Mari
description: After being assigned as study partners, two Chicana high schoolers find a bond that confuses them at times.

title: Samy y yo
description: Samy Goldstein, a writer for a television program, is surrounded by an oppressive female environment. Then decides to resume his passion for literature. Meet Mary, a beauty in crisis. From there a series of misunderstandings will happen.

title: Donramon y Perchita
description: Online series about the adventures of DonRamon and Perchita

title: Y++
description: A series of sketches about the miseries of life in the 21st century and its effects on the human condition.

title: Carne y arena
description: Based on true accounts, the superficial lines between subject and bystander are blurred and bound together, allowing individuals to walk in a vast space and thoroughly live a fragment of the refugees' personal journeys.

title: Andrea y Lorenzo
description: Andrea is a young journalist who feels her professional and personal life have come to a halt. But the return of Lorenzo, her former college flame she once dumped, now turned rock star, will give her a new perspective on life, love and being true to herself.

title: Cabeza y corazón
description: The only time the Spanish women's wheelchair basketball team participated in the Paralympic Games was in Barcelona in 1992, when Spain was granted the place as the host country without the need to qualify. Twenty-four years later, for the first time in history, the team once again has the chance to compete in the Paralympics. Despite having fewer resources than other countries' teams, the Spanish team is making its way against all odds in the international competitions. An intimate, player's-eye view follows the physical and psychological journey leading to the team's historic qualification for the Paralympic Games in Tokyo 2020-21.

title: Donaire y Esplendor

description: After her husband's tragic murder, a recently widowed woman seeks solace in Las Vegas, determined to make a fresh start for herself and her daughter. title: Panienka z poste restante
description: Three years after the death of his wife, Waldemar still cannot forget her. Lucia is a woman in love with Waldemar, and Bohdan Michorowski is in love with Lucia... but so is Count Brochwicz! The two men come head to head during a New Year`s Eve party, and Waldemar has to step in to avert disaster. Minely trzy lata od smierci ukochanej Waldemara, Stefci. Ordynat nie moze o niej zapomniec. Kocha sie w nim, bez wzajemnosci, Lucia. W niej zas zakochany jest Bohdan Michorowski. O reke Luci stara sie rowniez hrabia Brochwicz. Na balu sylwestrowym dochodzi do scysji pomiedzy Brochwiczem i Bohdanem Michorowskim. Bohdan wyzywa go na pojedynek, ale Waldemar, jako glowa rodziny, korzysta z prawa pierwszenstwa i staje na placu boju zamiast Bohdana. Zwycieza. Lucia i Bohdan postanawiaja sie pobrac, a ordynat mianuje go swoim nastepca. Wykorzystujac powodzenie Tredowatej Henryk Szaro sfilmowal dalszy ciag tej powiesci. Ordynat Michorowski zostal zrealizowany w konwencji dramatu z wyzszych sfer, z elementami sensacji. Prezentuje on przecietny poziom komercyjnych filmow tamtego okresu.

title: Z Storm
description: This is a story about the biggest financial fraud attempted in Hong Kong, directed at the Government of Hong Kong and involved all 7 million Hong Kong citizens... no one is free from the scheme. Within the four decades of guarding Hong Kong's financial integrity, the ICAC has never come across an opponent so huge and so well organized as in the Z Torrent file... shadowy figures from the underworld of South America, Italy and Europe all ready to plot against the estimated 150 million dollars of Hong Kong citizens' tax money which was pooled in a fund called the WELFARE FUND. High profile chartered accountants, high ranking law enforcers, power lawyers, the super entrepreneurs; they all have their shares of play but none can really grasp the big picture; they are there only for what they desire most. When the wife of an up-rising star Superintendent of police force reported his corruption simply out of bitterness for being ill-treated, little did she know she is about to pull the head string from a very well weaved web of deceive, greed, sex, power, and last but not least, fear. The ICAC agent LOK who took charge of the simple complaint felt otherwise... it's his passion for justice that has been driving him all these years in the battle against bribery and corruption, even after losing his beloved wife. Further investigation soon revealed many unanswered questions and loose ends...the death of an ex-godfather status accountant of Hong Kong, the threats to even the seemingly harmless witnesses and informers, and the surfacing of a mysterious lady that has all connection with LOK's wanted list but with a background as simple and as tragic as a girl next door with terminal illness... As Lok dug deeper into the web, he is being hunted by trained foreign mercenaries; a tactic very seldom or never heard of in the history of Hong Kong's underworld! With the support of his superior the old but streetwise Deputy Chief of ICAC, Lok eventually unlocked the door to the plan, but only after a bloodbath gun battle that almost cost him his life and that of the attractive mysterious woman, Angel.

Ruthless terrorists seize a London embassy residence. The SAS are called in. There's intense political pressure for a quick resolution. The worst fears of David Barber, the officer in command, are tragically realised. With a brilliant career in ruins, the prospects for ex-Major Barber seem grim until he meets Colonel Patrick Ansell, Managing director of Saracen systems Ltd.

title: Gaki No Tsukai
description: A mix of game show, talk show and reality show. Downtown sees five comedians humiliate and torture themselves and each other for our amusement.

Stormin norman vs andrew
Anyone 18-60 is allowed to fight for us, and we will honor your backyard record if you have video proof of the matches. Sign up in our Facebook group. We are ONLY located in Gig Harbor Washington State. No pay/charging to fight involved. 

The Scrapyard holds Monthly fights in our location of Gig Harbor Washington, sign up on facebook. Sign up, show up, get matched up, FIGHT!
Hosted by - Firechicken

Links Below
INSTAGRAM: / https://www.instagram.com/streetbeefs_scrapyard/
FACEBOOK: / https://www.facebook.com/groups/StreetbeefsScrapyard
TIKTOK: / https://www.tiktok.com/@Streetbeefs_Scrapyard
Firechicken's INSTAGRAM: / https://www.instagram.com/fir3chick3n/

LinkTree-https://linktr.ee/streetbeefsscrapyard

Sponsors-
HKA USA - https://hkausa.com/
https://peixotto.com/
https://www.Sasquatchthelegend.com 
Big shoutout to our entire media team! Logan, Chris, Chandra, Juggalo J!

Join this channel to get access to perks:
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC2Tr7vqNAg32eozqAuElfZQ/join

Alternate angle channel - https://www.youtube.com/@ScrapyardSTREETBEEFS
Email - Scrapyardfighting@gmail.com
Facebook group- https://www.facebook.com/groups/StreetbeefsScrapyard
Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/streetbeefs_scrapyard/

ALL STUNTS AND MATCHES ARE FILMED IN A CONTROLLED ENVIRONMENT WITH SAFETY BEING THE MOST IMPORTANT FACTOR.

No Money involved. Pay or charging. We arent open to the public for spectating. email me if you have a reason you want to come out. 

Join this channel to get early access to the fights before they release to the public! 

DO YOU WANT TO FIGHT??? join our Facebook or IG and contact us. OR email us 

OUR MATCHES ARE 100% LEGAL. ALL PARTICIPANTS MUST BE 18 OR OLDER. Welcome to the Scrapyard! We are a LEGAL backyard Fight organization Located in the Pacific Northwest. The Scrapyard was created in 2019 by "Firechicken", a former Amateur MMA fighter, Wrestling coach, and Boxer. The Scrapyard holds monthly fights in our Pacific northwest location. No money is involved in any way, we do not pay fighters or charge any sort of admission to our events. We aim to give people a place to start their combat sports journey, meet people, solve beefs, or just test out their abilities. 

All sign ups are done on our facebook group only

ALL SCRAPYARD MATCHES ARE AMATEUR EXHIBITIONS

The political thriller, which is partly inspired by 2 Baba's shelved 2017 protests stars Alexx Ekubo in the lead role of Justin Aba, a socially conscious afro-pop artiste with a large following. When Justin Aba decides to use his influence to stage a protest against the policies of the incumbent government, he is drawn into a game of politics he didn't bargain for. This film shows the twists, turns, and intrigue of a proposed protest march called by an influential pop artiste, that shook the socio-political landscape of Nigeria to its very foundation. Nerves are stretched to breaking point as the decision to take ownership and execute the protest throws up intriguing reactions from security operatives, political players, hustlers and opportunists Power of 1 stars Ramsey Nouah, Anne Idibia, Jide Kosoko and Michelle Dede. The film was released in cinemas nationwide last December and has played in theatres in the UK and US.

title: Baalveer 4
description: Ageel and Shashmaag aim for world domination, but Baalveer stands in their way. Freed from captivity, Bhasma resumes his malicious plans to eliminate Baalveer while his enemies conspire to disrupt the balance on Earth.

title: Day 4
description: Instead of being open with her son about a traumatic event from her past, a woman decides to repress the details, which ultimately damages their relationship.

title: Good Boy
description: After living a lonely life and dying in an accident at age thirty, a man is given a second chance to go back in time. He wakes up as a teenager during his school years and decides to live a different life.

title: Persona4 the ANIMATION
description: A young man, Yu Narukami has moved from Tokyo to Inaba to stay with his uncle and cousin, while his parents are away on business. However, after several murders shake up the sleepy town, things get crazier when he discovers the mysterious "Midnight Channel," and the ability to enter TVs. Accompanied by his friends, Yu explores another world inside the TV, that seems to be connected with the murders. They also discover the ability to summon 'Personas', their 'other selves', whose power they can use to fight the shadows that inhabit the TV world. The murders, the Midnight Channel, the world inside the TV, and Personas. Yu and his friends fight to figure out how they're connected, and to solve the case before it's too late.

Complemented by their landlord's hyperactive daughter Jasmijn De Ridder, they soon form a crazy but close group of friends. title: Ab heute erwachsen
description: The saga of Stefan (David C. Bunners), an 18-year-old construction worker who struggles to make it on his own is the theme that winds its way through this look at growing up. There are surprises in store for the young lad once he manages to move into his own apartment (he had a hard time telling his mother he was moving out). His landlord exploits his good nature to get him to do work around the house and to do favors for his friends too. Stefan's relationship with his mother is already strained after he moved out, and when she discovers how he is being used she really loses it. In an attempt to apologize, she gives Stefan her apartment to watch while she is away for awhile. He opportunistically decides to bring his new girlfriend home overnight, with comic and unforeseen consequences to his relationship with her and his mother.

title: ICC Cricket World Cup
description: The 2015 Cricket World Cup (officially known as ICC Cricket World Cup 2015) was the 11th Cricket World Cup, jointly hosted by Australia and New Zealand from 14 February to 29 March 2015. In the Final Australia defeated New Zealand by 7 wickets to win their fifth ICC Cricket World Cup.

title: Ab Ke Baras [Hindi]
description: Circa British rule a group of revolutionaries headed by Abhay aspires for a free India when Abhay, his beloved Nandini and other revolutionaries are betrayed and killed by traitor, Tejeshwar Singhal. Years later Abhay and Nandini are re-incarnated into different house-holds while Tejeshwar is now a Minister within the Government. Meanwhile Abhay now called Karan while Nandini now called Anjali re-unites from their respective domains to take revenge on Tejeshwar once and for all.

title: Meri Aashiqui Ab Tum Hi Ho [Hindi]
description: Meri Aashiqui Ab Tum Hi Ho is a heartbreaking romantic drama of eternal love, sacrifice, and fate. Meera’s world shatters when she discovers Arjun’s betrayal, unaware he is hiding a fatal illness and pushing her away to protect her dreams. As secrets, scandals, and destiny collide, their love is tested to its final breath—where passion meets tragedy in the most unforgettable way.

title: Gaddi Jaandi Ae Chalaangaan Maardi [Punjabi]
description: A doomed car is the center of comic situations in this story that follows Ammy Virk, who belongs to a middle-class family of 8. His materialistic father is convinced by him to let him marry the girl of his choice. A small car is given by the girl's family as a dowry, and that pleases the father's greed. Yet, the car breaks when the 8 members of the family try to fit in the 4-seater.

title: Sa-rang-hu-ae
description: Kim Sung-Joon (Park Si-Hoo) worked as a pilot, but after becoming in deaf in his right ear he has worked on the ground. He becomes desperate. Kim Sung-Joon then meets Eun-Hong (Yoon Eun-Hye) on a blind date. Even though he doesn't love her, he gets married to Eun-Hong. After their marriage, Sung-Joon treats Eun-Hong with indifference. Suddenly, Eun-Hong dies. Kim Sung-Joon soon learns for the first time about her real heart and her first love. Holding Eun-Hong's urn, he seeks out her first love.

title: Wolhaui gongdongmyoji
description: The kisaeng (korean geisha) Wol-ha marries Kim Han-su, but soon dies because of a false accusation made up by her husbands mother and her servant. Now the ghost of Wol-ha wants revenge!

title: Like a Dandelion
description: The three Park sisters try to find their own paths to love and happiness. But Ji Won (Song Sun Mi), Mi Won (Maya) and Hye Won (Lee Yoon Ji) make very different decisions in their lives to get there.

title: Putting Lipstick on a Pig
description: Paivi is in her 50's and lives on Aland, an island in Finland with 30 000 people. We have our own government which can decide some things independently of the Finnish government: taxes, hunting, gambling etc. Paivi is a single mother and when her boys move out she is alone. She looks for company online and finds gambling. She gets addicted. She is an accountant and has access to money. Things go out of hand. Suddenly she has lost 819 000 - of her clients money! She is caught and it is a big scandal. She tries to commit suicide but gets jail. The clients are angry, they trusted her! It gets worse. It turns out she lost it all to the local gambling company. They hold a monopoly license to prevent from addiction and criminality - exactly what they didn't. The money went to the local government and they distributed it to the people: to football associations, research etc. It all turns into a money laundry case, the first in Finnish legal history to involve a gambling company. But the government refuses to pay back the money which make Paivis former clients furious. The movie had a preview on Aland where it ran for four days and won the audience award. Public opinion became strong and the government now have to plan on how to pay back and how to prevent this from happening again. But people get addicted to gambling everyday. Right now someone is losing everything. Right now, a gambler filled with guilt tries to kill herself. This is just the story of one gambler.

title: 7 Welcome to London
description: Indian immigrant Jai finds friendship and love, upon arriving in London. However one phone call changes everything, thrusting him into a dark and dangerous situation.

Chronicling the trials and tribulations of three young Tamil men. A bright underachiever, the impressionable 23-year old Anpu, who lives with his no-nonsense disciplinarian father. Trapped in a self-perpetuating cycle of isolation, Anpu finds salvation with a local gang. A charismatic gang leader Kumar, who maintains a strong sense of comradely and a code of honour among his members. Gang life is not something he enjoys nor he chose, but circumstances forced him into it and he is waiting for an opportune time to get out. And, far removed from them is an ambitious student Ahilan, who has managed to surmount enormous challenges in life through his positive outlook and determination. They have treaded very different paths in their lives, yet their fates become inexorably tied to each other's. Anpu's involvement in Kumar's gang blossoms into a strong friendship between the two, based on trust and respect. Former classmates and friends, Ahilan and Anpu have grown distant over time due to a girl in their lives. These young men's stories couldn't be more different, yet one thread links them all. All of them are victims of the brutal civil war in Sri Lanka. That fateful bright Saturday starts like any other, and no one could have predicted the chain of events that are about to unfold that will change their lives forever.

title: Ah! My Goddess: Flights of Fancy [English] S1-S2
description: Set one year after Aa. Megami-sama!. The song may say thank heaven for little girls, but whom is college student Morisato Keiichi supposed to thank when three honest to goodness Goddesses move in and take over his life? And should he really be all that grateful? After all, according to most mythologies, relationships between mortals and immortals usually leads to mortifying complications, so we're already talking about an extremely mixed blessing. And when a fourth Goddess suddenly appears, that blessing quickly becomes a curse. Keiichi's new friends may be trying to help, but sometimes Belldandy, Skuld, Urd, and Peorth seem less concerned with Keiichi's safety than they are with establishing a pecking order and ownership rights. The delicate celestial balance that exists between human and goddess is thrown into complete and utter chaos.

title: Ai him yan muk
description: Feng (Shawn Yue) is a former undercover cop whose post-assignment life has begun to rapidly disintegrate. Feng and former triad brother Fai (Sam Lee of Gen-X Cops) are caught using cocaine, and the ensuing melee leaves a police detective dead, with Fai fingered as the culprit. Fai must go on the run, but he no longer trusts Feng, who he believes may be leveraging their brotherhood for advancement in the police ranks.

title: Ai no kudaranai
description: Kei Tamai, an assistant producer at a regional TV station, is trying to have a baby with her live-in boyfriend Yoshi. He says he'll marry her once she gets pregnant, having given up his dream of making it big as a comedian, and frequently skips work, which has gradually cooled Kei's feelings for him. She secretly takes contraceptives, and devotes herself to her job. One day, Kei's irritation with the whining Yoshi reaches a peak, and she starts to walk out on him. In desperation, he tries to stop her by dropping a bombshell: "I'm pregnant, so let's get married." As Kei's career and relationship go off the rails, she is forced to confront her own obliviousness.

title: Mittsu no ai
description: In a mountain village, Heita, a translator's son, is a gifted boy but is shunned by the villagers. He can imitate birds' cry and befriends another boy who works in a brewery. Heita also finds solace in the village pastor Yasugi and his teacher Michiko, but they too have problems of their own.

title: Ai nostri
description: Two completely different families, Ciorba and Ghica, have a single thing in common, which, unfortunately, they can't avoid: the love between their kids. The two children from the families, Irina and Horatiu, fall in love and they decide to take the big step: marriage. Although the interests of the two families have no common point, the young lovers are convinced that this will not be an obstacle to happiness. A large family: Ai nostri (2017)

title: Ai wo tsumu hito
description: Atsushi was a dedicated and serious worker for all of his adult life. Now retired to the northern territory of Hokkaido with his wife Ryoko, Atsushi is at a loss with what to do with all the time on his hands. As Atsushi busies himself with erecting a stone gate to surround their new home, a local lad is recruited to help, the couple's reconciling daughter comes to visit and Ryoko holds a secret close to her bosom.

title: Ai Ai
description: Zainab 's father dead body is mistaken for the body of a high minister which is planed to march through a public parade. Comparison between the life and death of the poor and the rich and powerful is made in a comic way.

title: Ai no uta
description: A drama about a man and woman who come to know true love after unexpected circumstances cause them to live under the same roof. Singer and songwriter Tamaki Koji returns to acting after a 8 year hiatus, to star opposite Kanno Miho in this drama. Koji plays a very kind policeman; a champion of the weak and a pacifist. Having lost his wife 4 years earlier, he has been saddled with the arduous task of raising 3 children single-handedly. Kanno stars as the unfortunate heroine with an ugly personality who grows through her encounters with this good natured middle aged man.

title: Ima ai ni yukimasu
description: Yuuji is still a first-grade student, he is having a very hard time understanding what has happened to his mother and the fact that she won't be coming back. At the very beginning , the voice of the late mother is reading from a picture book that she wrote for Yuuji before she died. It is about a mother who dies, but promises to return when the rainy season comes. Yuuji believes in this story and thinks that his mother will come back when the rainy season comes. And surprisingly - she actually does. When it begins raining on a June morning, Yuuji runs out into the forest to the special place where he used to play with his mother. His father, Takumi chases after him to get him to go to school. When they arrive at the old ruined building where they used to play, Yuuji's mother, Mio is waiting there completely alive and healthy, but she has no memory of them or anything that occurred during her life.

title: Zhen ai 100 tian
description: When a cold hearted telecommunications executive returns to his small island town for his estranged mother's burial, he learns about the true Taiwanese tradition that mandates him to marry within 100 days so that the parent's spirit can transition peacefully. When a typhoon leaves him stranded for 3 days, he rekindles romance with his free spirited, childhood sweetheart who is engaged to marry a local villager/step brother.

title: Ai Que Vida!
description: Cleonice decides to run for mayor while his son, Valdir, pays his respects to a philanthropic institution and ends up falling in love with a girl. In the fictional Poço Fundo, politics and affection mingle in saga against corruption.

title: Vacanze ai Caraibi
description: Three comedic and intertwined episodes.

title: AI Dungeon
description: Simon, Lewis and friends play AI Dungeon, a role playing game in which you can type anything and the AI will guide you on a crazy adventure.

title: Ai no onimotsu
description: Jozaburo Araki is the head of a famous family-owned wholesale pharmaceutical store with a well-established history. At present he is the Minister of Health and Welfare, and is considering submission of a Bill to hold population increase in check, in an attempt to easily deal with Opposition accusations regarding the population problem. However, just when he is in the Diet giving a major policy speech to the Welfare Ministry Committee about decreasing the population, Ranko, his 48-year-old wife, heads to a maternity clinic and discovers that she is pregnant. To make matters worse, he finds out that his eldest son, Jotaro, had been secretly having an affair with his own secretary, Saeko Godai, and it seems that she is also expecting a little 'Burden of Love.' Also, the Araki family's young daughter, Sakura, has become pregnant with her fiancé before their upcoming marriage, and even the retired patron of the family, Jozo, 2 presents yet another possibility of a pregnancy with his much younger mistress. Furthermore, Jozaburo visits Kyoto on an election campaign and is astounded to learn of the existence of his own love-child with his former lover, Some Kaida! As if that's not enough trouble, the Araki family finds that even their maid, Oteru, and their business manager, Yamaguchi, have somehow also ended up with their own 'Burden of Love.' And that is how the population explosion in the household of the Minister of Health and Welfare somehow becomes a factor in the future of Japan...

title: AI Sponge
description: In this AI Parody of Spongebob Squarepants, witness the infinite and wacky escapades of Spongebob, Patrick, Loudward, and more.

title: Ai no kotodama
description: Ootani and Tachibana have been inseparable since high school. Now that they're in college, they live together, they're happy and everything seems prefect. But their little world is disrupted when they meet an old high school friend, Yuki, who seems to have a crush on Tachibana, making Ootani feel jealous and insecure. Will Tachibana really choose him over a pretty girl?

title: Ai qing de dai jia
description: A physically deformed musical genius named Wu Sheng falls for a blind girl named Jui Fang, but when she's on the verge of regaining her eyesight from an operation, he leaves the country for fear.

title: In coda ai titoli
description: "In Coda Ai Titoli" is a collection of beautifully photographed interviews with the people behind the scenes in the history of the great Cinecitta studios in Rome. Electricians, Grips and others speak about the stars of the old times and give us an inside view of their secret attitudes and behaviors.

title: Zheng qing kuang ai
description: Two girls of disparate class backgrounds suffer through teenage rebellion, drug abuse, and prostitution in cutting-edge Taipei.

title: AI Amok
description: Artificial Intelligence has permeated every aspect of planetary life in 2030. Tokyoites experience AI in every aspect of their lives whether medical, finance, transportation or their personal and day-to-day interactions. Many would tell you that AI is indispensable. Yet, as is often the case with technology jumping the gun on ethics and rules AI spins out of control and causes calamity after calamity. The city and the country are in chaos.

title: The Gene of AI
description: A doctor who treats robot and humanoid problems takes place in the near future when humanoids with AI account for 10% of the population. Hikaru Sudô, also known as Moggadeet, secretly takes on illegal medical procedures.

title: Ai cao
description: A woman who believes she chose an unconventional path in her life is startled to find her children are stepping farther beyond society's boundaries in this drama from Taiwanese filmmaker Hsiu-Chiung Chiang. Ai-tsao (Li-li Pan) is a widow who is nearly 60 years old; her husband, over twenty years her senior, has been dead for nearly two decades, and Ai-tsao's life has settled into a comfortable routine of looking after her elderly mother and doting on her two adult children. Ai-tsao had a strong independent streak when she was young and struck out on her own over the objections of her parents, but she's not quite as willing to accept that her children have chosen lives different from her own. Ai-tsao slowly comes to the realization that her son is gay and struggles to come to terms with his lifestyle, but it's even more difficult for Ai-tsao when she discovers her daughter is going to be the unwed mother of a mixed-race child.

title: My Sibling's Romance China
