title: The Rising Son - From Shame to Supremacy
description: Micro Drama

title: Sauda Pyaar Ka
description: Sauda Pyaar Ka is an emotional romance where a humble tailor secretly lives a double life as India's biggest fashion tycoon. While he sacrifices everything for the woman he loves, she betrays him for wealth and status—only to discover his true identity when it's too late. A story of love, heartbreak, betrayal, and redemption.

title: My PA is a Political Prince
description:
My PA Is a Political Prince

Fearless activist Riya dreams of changing the world, unaware that her unpaid PA, Aryaman, is actually the heir to a powerful political dynasty. As love grows between them, ambitious politician Vikram pulls Riya into a dangerous world of fame and power. Torn between love and ambition, Riya must discover who truly stands by her before she loses everything.

title: Mere Papa Heeralal
description: When a self-made billionaire CEO is forced to fake a marriage with a poor lift mechanic to protect her son and save her empire, neither of them realizes that they are actually reunited lovers, the child's real parents, and heirs to a secret that will shake Mumbai's most powerful families.

title: Cruel Attraction
description: After being framed and imprisoned for a crime she didn't commit, Chandni returns home determined to find her missing younger sister. Forced into a dangerous deal with the notorious playboy Luv Rathore, she agrees to seduce his golden-boy brother Kush as part of a revenge scheme. But as buried secrets surface, Chandni discovers that one brother may be the villain everyone loves—and the other may be the devil willing to save her.

title: The Gangster King
description: Veer is secretly a super powerful  and influential man controlling pokiticians and business men, while he pretends to be a cleaner - and ends up in a contract marriage with a businesswoman, whom he protects and gradually falls for. This businesswoman, Tara, faces problems created by her own family members along with a powerful and dangerous man - but Veer is too powerful and influential for all of them. He overpowers all the problems, while hiding his reality all this time.

title: Super Dad Sunil Tyagi
description: A scrap dealer secretly living as a billionaire tests his daughter’s strength and love. When her rich fiancé betrays and humiliates them, the truth is revealed—bringing justice, redemption, and proving that real wealth is character, not money.

title: Khoon Ka Rishta [Hindi]
description: When blind but brilliant photographer Zoya crosses paths with brooding businessman Yug Singhania, sparks fly in unexpected ways. As love blossoms through secrets, emotional wounds, and societal barriers, Zoya becomes Yug’s guiding light and he becomes her strength. Together, they discover that true vision comes not from the eyes, but from the heart.

title: The Triple Crown
description: After a fatal accident, a delivery boy is reincarnated as a weak scholar in an ancient village. Guided by a stylish genie, he must navigate a new life while married to a princess, a warrior, and a merchant’s daughter. Using modern knowledge and magical boons, he protects his home from bandits and corrupt soldiers. As he wins his wives' devotion, he transforms from a "mad bookworm" into a powerful, beloved ruler.

title: Ajnabi Rishta
description:
Baby Loading Pyaar Pending is an engaging story of a pregnant college student, who fights stigma, poverty, and heartbreak while hiding a marriage born of sacrifice.
A powerful CEO unknowingly crosses paths with the wife he once rejected. Fate forces truth, redemption, and love to reunite a broken family. Watch now.

title: Who picked Mr. Fu's Rose [Hindi]
description: Who picked Mr. Fu's Rose

title: Ajnabi ka Intezar Hai
description: A broken woman, robbed of motherhood, finds unexpected love in a humble construction worker—unaware he’s a secret billionaire hiding his true identity. As their fragile romance deepens, dark secrets, betrayal, and a stolen child resurface, forcing them to fight against fate, enemies, and shattered trust to claim the family they were destined for.

title: Love Gamble
description: Love Gamble is a drama mini-series that follows the unlikely connection between a wealthy nightclub owner and a struggling young woman. The story begins when Litika, a homeless woman, rescues an expensive watch belonging to Nishant Singhaniya, a powerful club owner. Grateful and intrigued, Nishant brings Litika into his world, offering her a job and a place to stay.

title: Don In Uniform
description: Yash, ek underworld don, school ke ladke Rahul ko bachate hue maara gaya, aur uski aatma Rahul ke andar bas gayi. Kamzor aur bechaara Rahul, jise sab kam aankte the, ab Yash ki taakat aur swag ke saath badalne laga. Yash ne Rahul ko sambhalne aur uska graduation ka sapna poora karne ka faisla kiya. School mein Rahul hero ban gaya, ladkiyan uske charm ki deewani ho gayi. Lekin padhai aur beeta hua past uske liye badi chunauti ban gaye. Kahi Yash Rahul ko apni tarah criminal to nahi bana dega?

title: Billionaire's Journey From Kanpur To London
description: A secret billionaire endures years of abuse from his ungrateful wife in London before reclaiming his Indian empire and a new life. After a high-stakes plane crisis, he finds true love with a kind flight attendant who respected him even when he posed as a lowly cleaner. When his bankrupt ex-wife unknowingly returns to beg for his investment, she is publicly exposed and disgraced. The humble hero and his new queen ultimately unite their worlds of immense wealth and rural tradition.

title: Billionaire ka Safar
description: In a single day, aboard a train heading back to his village, billionaire Rajat Mhatre’s worlds collide—his hidden identity, his forgotten family, and the ruthless man who tormented them. What begins as a journey home turns into a battle for dignity, justice, and truth. As the village celebrates a grand resort project led by the arrogant Nitin, they are unaware that the real power - “The Silver Lord” - has arrived to reclaim everything that was once stripped from him.

title: Breakup Se Bana Billionaire
description: After being dumped at the marriage registrar for a richer man, struggling techie Aditya impulsively marries a stranger, Preeti, unaware she is a billionaire CEO. What begins as a deal-driven marriage turns explosive when Aditya is revealed to be the long-lost heir of a powerful business family, and the very man who humiliated him becomes his rival. As love, identity, and ambition collide, Aditya must choose between revenge, legacy, and the woman who believed in him first.

title: Queen Of Snakes
description: Devika thought she had found love, only to discover her husband, Vikrant, was a prince who conspired to destroy her unborn child. Brutalized by his lawful wife and carrying the bloodline of an enemy who wiped out her village, Devika was forced to embrace her identity as a powerful Naag Kanya. As ancient curses flared, she watched her betrayers rot from within, proving that no one escapes the bite of karma.

title: Unknown Connection
description: Ananya is told her newborn twins died, but her step-sister Sonal secretly sold them to Aradhya. Seven years later, Ananya meets wealthy CEO Arjun (posing as a driver) and his twins—her biological children. As she bonds with them, Aradhya returns claiming her "family," while Sonal's torment continues. Birthmarks and connections reveal the truth: Sonal's betrayal, Aradhya's fake pregnancy, and Arjun's deception. Ananya reunites with her children and marries Arjun.

title: Pati, Patni aur Dhokha
description: Pati, Patni aur Dhokha ek intense relationship thriller hai jo marriage, infidelity aur obsession ke dark side ko explore karta hai. Yeh kahani ek aurat ke tootne aur phir apne aap ko dobara khada karne ki journey hai. Show poochta hai—kya pyaar ke naam par har zulm maaf ho sakta hai? Aur jab ek aurat apni had se aage badh jaaye, toh kya woh victim rehti hai ya hunter ban jaati hai?

title: My Crazy Ex-Girlfriend
description: Hardik Goyal’s perfect life collapses when he loses his company, reputation, and fiancée overnight. Betrayed and broken, fate pulls him into the shadowy world of the mafia, where power replaces principles. As danger escalates, Hardik reconnects with Niharika, his childhood savior, discovering love, strength, and destiny. Choosing the mafia becomes his only way to protect love, family, and his future.

title: The Layoff That Shook the Company [Hindi]
description: In a high-stakes world of corporate power and betrayal, former tech prodigy Ethan finds himself caught between loyalty and revenge. As the mighty Blackwell Group crumbles due to internal politics and personal vendettas, Ethan must decide whether to save the empire that wronged him—or let it burn. A gripping tale of ambition, heartbreak, and redemption in the ruthless tech industry.

title: Sweet Revenge
description: Sweet Revenge is a dramatic tale of love, betrayal, and justice. Rachit, a devoted husband and real author behind his wife Prerna’s success, sacrifices everything for her—only to be cheated, framed, and abandoned. As truth unfolds, Rachit rises to reclaim his identity, expose deceit, and find true love, while Prerna faces the consequences of her greed. Watch now.

title: Delivery Boy Vs Billionaires
description: Billionaire is mistaken as a Delivery Boy.

title: The Billionaire's Deal
description: The Billionaire's Deal is a modern love-hate saga between Yukanika , a shy medical student burdened by her family’s debts, and Vikrant , a cold, arrogant billionaire with a dark past. When fate forces Yukanika to work as Vikrant’s personal secretary to repay her late father’s loan, sparks ignite between the fiery opposites. What begins as a battle, but slowly turns into a desire, power, and redemption, where love might heal the beast or destroy the beauty forever. Watch now!

title: The Ba***ds of Boardroom [Tamil]
description: The Ba***ds of Boardroom is an engaging story of a mother sacrifices everything to raise a child she believes is hers. Betrayal, greed, and blood ties collide inside boardrooms and bedrooms alike. When the final chess move is revealed, only one woman stands victorious. Watch now.

title: Billionaire Groom is my new husband
description: Billionaire Groom is my new husband

title: My Husband Is A Ghost Hunter
description: Naina , a widowed gold magnate, marries Arjun Varma to protect her daughter and her collapsing empire, believing he is only a broken ex-convict. When powerful gold syndicates attack her business and target her child, a buried truth explodes. Her husband Arjun Varma is actually Ghost Hunter, a man once feared by governments and erased from history. As a contract marriage turns real, a caged monster rises to protect his family and claim his throne.

title: Billion Dollar Mess [Telugu]
description: When airline tycoon Veer Chopra falls for the charming flight attendant Lara Smith, he thinks he has found his perfect match. But when his unsuspecting parents, Rajesh and Vinita Chopra, fly in to meet their future daughter-in-law, a shocking web of arrogance, deception, and humiliation unfolds mid-air turning love into the costliest mistake of Veer’s life.

title: Vaikuntapuramlo [Telugu]
description: A successful CEO finally finds the son he lost 20 years ago after years of struggle. But just when he thinks life has given him back what he lost, shocking twists turn his world upside down. This is a family drama filled with suspense and twist upon twist.

title: SPY x FAMILY [Hindi]
description:
Everyone has a part of themselves they cannot show to anyone else.

At a time when all nations of the world were involved in a fierce war of information happening behind closed doors, Ostania and Westalis had been in a state of cold war against one another for decades. The Westalis Intelligence Services' Eastern-Focused Division (WISE) sends their most talented spy, "Twilight," on a top-secret mission to investigate the movements of Donovan Desmond, the chairman of Ostania's National Unity Party, who is threatening peace efforts between the two nations.

This mission is known as "Operation Strix." It consists of "putting together a family in one week in order to infiltrate social gatherings organized by the elite school that Desmond's son attends."

"Twilight" takes on the identity of psychiatrist Loid Forger and starts looking for family members. But Anya, the daughter he adopts, turns out to have the ability to read people's minds, while his wife, Yor, is an assassin! With it being in each of their own interests to keep these facts hidden, they start living together while concealing their true identities from one another.
World peace is now in the hands of this brand-new family as they embark on an adventure full of surprises.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

title: Tokyo Twenty Fourth Ward [Hindi]
description: Enter the 24th Ward, a man-made island inside Tokyo Bay. Three of its inhabitants: Shuta, Ran, and Koki, have been best friends since childhood, but after a deadly incident, everything changed. A year later, reunited for the first time, they receive a mysterious phone call. On the other line is a familiar voice from a friend who's supposed to be dead. Together, they'll have to save their home.

title: Handyman Saitou in another world [Hindi]
description: Handyman Saitou has never felt special in his life. When he's dropped into a medieval fantasy world, he gathers a party of unique beings to survive. Surrounded by a heavy warrior, a spell-forgetting wizard, and even a divine fairy princess, he yearns to be helpful. But after Saitou saves everyone during a raid, it's clear that having a handyman on an adventure isn't just useful, it's essential.

In her past life, Myla Scott sacrificed the respect and dignity of being the eldest daughter of the Scott family to marry Shawn Ford, only to endure endless humiliation. In Halton, everyone knew that Shawn's true love was Susan Quinn, and Myla was nothing more than an afterthought. Shawn despised her, drained every last ounce of value from her, and left her to die a painful death on the operating table.
But this time, in her second life, Myla is determined to take control. She focuses on rebuilding herself, striving for success in both her career and love life. What she doesn't expect is for her cold and indifferent ex-husband to suddenly change, becoming obsessed with winning her back. As their complicated relationship reignites, the truth behind her tragic death in her past life begins to surface.

title: A Miracle a Day
description: The documentary film "A Miracle A Day," is an uplifting testament to the human spirit and it's capacity to surmount obstacles and transcend adversity. It is a portrayal of All Bengal Women's Union Welfare Home For Girls in Kolkata (Calcutta), India, which is a progressive present-day example of the older institutions depicted in the highly acclaimed film "Lion", whose story also took place in Kolkata. The home was founded in 1932 for women and girls to have a place of refuge from brothels, trafficking, poverty and abandonment. Today it is still thriving with residents ranging from one day old through their nineties. All Bengal Women's Union provides food, clothing, shelter, education and vocational training for 150 to 200 girls, young women, elderly and care for babies as well. The staff, many of whom are volunteers, show heartfelt and relentless dedication to helping every person become the best they can be.

description:

Baba Yaga never does magic for free, but it just so happens that she needs a wolf's keen nose for a secret plan she's brewing... "Karah Sutton has crafted a vivid and rollicking adventure that proves a wolf doesn't have to be big or bad to win the day!" description: Faye Locke gives up her career to become a devoted housewife, only to be betrayed by her husband. One rainy night, while rushing her sick child to the hospital, she mistakenly gets into Shane Hart's car. He assumes she's making up an excuse to get close to him and makes her get out. Later, he discovers that she is the woman who donated a kidney to him years ago and begins helping her. Gradually, their bond deepens.

title: Mamá,Vamos a Echar a la Impostora
description: Hace siete años, la verdadera heredera fue drogada y, a causa de una trampa de su madrastra y hermanastra, se vio obligada a pasar la noche con un desconocido. Tras el escándalo, la expulsaron de casa. Ahora regresa con sus tres hijos brillantes, decidida a vengarse. Sin embargo, cada vez que ve al prometido de su hermanastra, una extraña sensación de familiaridad la invade. Curiosamente, los niños están convencidos de que ese hombre es su padre. ¿Quién será el verdadero progenitor?

title: A God in a World Gone Mad
description: Ethan Locke is summoned into a mad, Cthulhu-like world. All life has mutated. Humanity cowers in 19 fortress cities, praying to various gods. He wakes as a god but impossibly weak. "This must be a mistake," he thinks. Now he must stitch together a broken world.

title: Judith: A Story of a Convert
description: This is the story of a young non-Jew German, daughter of a Protestant family, who immigrates to Israel. After several years living in Israel, she feels like bearing the "Mark of Cain", because of her foreign origin.

title: A Sun
description: A family of four fractures under the weight of unmet expectations, unexpected tragedy, and uncompromising pride.

title: I'm A Survivor No Longer A Victim
description: A documentary about women and men who have been victims of domestic violence and them telling their story of how they survived.

title: Komeda: A Soundtrack for a Life
description: Krzysztof Komeda was a jazz pianist and film composer. With compositions like the lullaby for Rosemary's Baby (1968) by Roman Polanski, Komeda succeeded in writing his own chapter in the history of soundtracks. This documentary follows the life story of the composer by the means of his melodic sounds. It is a reflection on his soundtracks, which changed the common film scores forever. It is a contemporary document about the attitude to life in a time of social, political and cultural change after war, about work and exodus of Polish artists in the 50s and 60s. A story about how film music is created and how it affects people. Directors who worked with Komeda and who are also friends talk about him: Roman Polanski, Jerzy Skolimowski, Henning Carlsen and Andrzej Wajda. His wife, Zofia Komeda, and his sister, Irena Orlowska, recollect him.

title: A Luna Rejeitada É a Alfa
description: O mundo de Alana se estrompa após perder sua alcateia e seu parceiro. Um ano depois, ela exige um divórcio de Victor quando ele traz sua amante, General Selene, para se apoderar da alcateia de Alana. Com a ajuda do Rei Alfa Carlos, Alana luta de volta. Enquanto o casamento de Victor e da Selene implode, Alana expõe sua cumplicidade com vampiros. Após uma feroz batalha, Alana recupera sua honra, restaura seu legado e encontra novamente o amor.

title: A Stepmother in a Blended Couple
description: Nina Vance and her daughter Mia marry doctor Arthur Hayes, who brings his daughter Chloe into the family. Grateful that Arthur spent over 300,000 USD on Mia's medical bills, Nina becomes a stay-at-home mom. However, manipulated by her biological mother Fiona, stepdaughter Chloe constantly torments Nina, calling her a homewrecker and a freeloader, ruining her clothes, and running away. Nina's mother-in-law also despises her for her second marriage, forcing a prenup. Enduring the humiliation, Nina secretly works part-time doing deliveries. When Chloe falls sick, Nina cares for her all night, slowly winning her heart. Ex-wife Fiona returns to cause trouble but is driven away by Chloe and Granny. The family finally reconciles, and on her birthday, Chloe wishes for Nina to be her biological mother. This story reveals the struggles of a stepmother, proving that genuine love ultimately wins hearts.

title: From a Whisper to a Scream
description: Out Of Ireland is the story of Irish popular music from 1950 to the present day told by the artists, songwriters, producers and executives who made it all happen. It tells of the dramatic evolution from a grey, conservative culture to a vibrant, colourful music scene which has an enormous popularity and influence completely out of proportion to the size of the country. Originally produced as a six part TV documentary series produced and directed by David Heffernan for RTE, it was broadcast under the title From A Whisper To A Scream.

title: Southeast: A City Within a City
description: The Southeast side is an overlooked, negatively stigmatized neighborhood of Chicago. This is a documentary about the aftermath of a place long abandoned, pushed to the side after it was no longer of use, and a story of heroes who lost sight of what they were fighting for. We will explore the anthropology of the area, learning how the various cultures and ethnicities bonded, clashed, and assimilated throughout time...and how this history played an effect on the relationships of those peoples moving forward. We will dive into the Vietnam War and government politics. We'll learn about street gang evolution and, of course, we will uncover the story of the steel mills. How did deindustrialization and disinvestment affect the community afterward? "SOUTHEAST: a city within a city" is a documentary that unfolds this story, showcasing the rise and demise of this empire of a place.

title: A Greyhound of a Girl
description: When the grandmother of the eleven years old aspiring chef Rose O'Hara suddenly ills, Rose meets the mysterious Anastasia to face the situation.

title: A Reckoning
description: After a her husband is brutally murdered, a widowed homesteader seeks revenge and leaves everything behind to hunt down his killer.

title: A Bug and a Bag of Weed
description: Peter Jordan is 33 years old and stuck in a dead end retail job at Super Duper Computers. To make matters worse, he's managed to rack up over $35,000 worth of debt. Student Loans, credit cards, Big Screen TV. His love life is equally in debt. Just when it seems he will never break out of his rut, an old high school buddy named Frehley shows up unexpectedly. Under Frehley's influence, Peter takes large cash advances on his newest credit card to go out every night. He even purchases his dream car, a classic '72 Volkswagen Bug. Frehley's easygoing take on life soon begins to affect Peter's co-workers as well. Before long Peter and his buddies Stan and Willie are having the time of their life. title: A Demonstration
description: "A Demonstration" is a monster film with no monsters. Inspired by the existence of taxonomies of monsters at the heart of Early Modern European science, the film explores and reinterprets a way of seeing the natural world that is almost impossible to imagine from today's vantage point. Early Modern naturalists were guided by a logic in which scientific truths were discovered through visual analogy. The word 'monster' comes from the latin 'monstrare', meaning to show, to reveal, to demonstrate. "A Demonstration" picks up on these themes in a poetic exploration of the boundaries of sight and the metamorphosis of form.

title: The Legendary Mage Returns
description: Three years ago, transcendent S-rank legend Aiden fell, cursed and amnesiac by the Devouring Abyss. Radiant Academy prodigy Irene risked her life with Soul Link to wake his memories and power. Wielding a simple training staff, he beats rivals from five academies and exposes traitor Lance. He and Irene unleash Ice-Thunder Twin Soul Resonance to slay the Abyss Nine-Headed Demon God and Maeve. At last, he crowns Irene with the S-rank Guardian Sacred Crown.

title: Immortal Samsara
description: A descendant of an ancient tribe, Yan Dan, falls for Lord Ying Yuan but must forget him for 800 years. With Yu Mo's aid, she helps demon hunter Tang Zhou, Ying Yuan's reincarnation, uncover mysteries while searching for ancient relics.

title: Plan C
description: Siblings Clare and Danny find themselves fugitives after a bungled robbery, leading them on a perilous journey filled with high-speed pursuits, moral dilemmas, and shocking revelations in the crime thriller "Plan C."

title: Three for Bedroom C
description: A film star and her young daughter stow away on a cross-country train to California. The compartment they invade belongs to a celebrated biology professor; romance blossoms. The star's manager turns up; complications ensue.

title: Cabine C
description: -Christiane Charette welcomes guests who all have in common that they are driven by their creativity, recognized in their field for their ability to innovate. Artists, managers, scientists, politicians, philosophers or journalists, all share their passion and enthusiasm in a close-up discussion.

title: The Best Thing [Hindi]
description: Workaholic hotel manager Shen Xi Fan meets gentle doctor He Su Ye while seeking treatment. Though initially doctor-patient, they unexpectedly live nearby, allowing love to bloom despite both nursing heartbreaks.

title: My Unicorn Girl [Hindi]
description: When she was eighteen, Sang Tian makes a wish to enter her mother's school to become part of the Chinese figure skating team. However, she did not pass the ranking test but somehow disguises as a guy and was accepted into the Ice Hockey team. Having no choice, she adopted a new identity. However, her plan was foiled by the sudden appearance of Wen Bing. Wen Bing and Sang Tian become room-mates. After one encounter, the two former "arch enemies" suddenly become good friends. The two of them decide to work together with their team mates and do their best in the championships. However, Sang Tian's secret was eventually exposed. Despite this, she still gets the chance to become a member of the first all-female Ice Hockey team. Sang Tian is finally able to become a real girl and continue chasing her dream.

title: C-Suite TV Insights
description: C-SUITE TV INSIGHTS is a program that takes you inside the minds of the most respected visionaries, thought leaders and entrepreneurs in the world.

title: Plan C-14 II
description:
Martin, an 83-year-old industrious man, will embark on a unique journey at 14.000 ft through the deserted highlands of the Argentine Andes mountains.

Plan C-14 II blends an air of melancholy and beauty as we admire the life of Martin Pueyrredon. He's 83 years old and has recently lost his wife of 60 years, followed by his best friend and traveling partner, with whom his outdoor adventures had taken on profound meaning. Their deaths leave him empty, even as he declares himself a "happy old man." He continues to work his engineering job, lays flowers on his wife's grave, and trains for another long adventure-this time, solo. It is important to have plans, he says. He is running out of time and against all odds and Doctor's recommendations, he is determined to have one last adventure before the end. His love and dedication for traveling are stronger than any medical diagnosis. Amid the windswept plains, canyons, dirt roads and high mountain passes of the Argentinean Andes, Pueyrredon repeats the final journey he made with his departed friend, bicycling alone for five days to a viaduct at 14,000 feet, guided by his memory. The film's most moving scene will challenge the dry eyes of even the sternest stoic. "I don't feel they are gone," Pueyrredon says of his wife and friend.

"What we realize through this film is that our most profound journeys can happen at any time in life - and perhaps the later we take them, the more rich and meaningful they become. And, no matter the challenges we face in life, there is always joy to be found - even in the most fleeting moments."


* Rebecca Martin, jury member

title: C-Suite with Jeffrey Hayzlett
description: "C-Suite with Jeffrey Hayzlett," is an original prime time series that features an inside look at companies that are shaping the global business landscape. In each week's 30-minute episode, Hayzlett, a contributing editor for Bloomberg Television and former c-suite executive who has led strategy on Wall Street and Main Street, spends time with the executive team of today's most recognized brands to discover what makes them tick. "C-Suite" profiles different business models, from big companies to insurgent start-ups that are disrupting their industry, offering new perspective on boardroom decision-making by top executives leading the way.

title: Love at 0°C
description: Sun Yixin is an aspiring fashion designer but is unable to find a job. Her friend Xiaoling aspires to enter high society and marry a rich man's son and often drags Yixin along to high-class parties. Yixin's mother forces her to help out with her cleaning business. She is forced to do the cleaning herself when she discovers that the business is in debt due to her mother's negligence. Her first assignment was to clean the house of Hu Zhitao, an irascible old man who looks after his grandson with an iron hand and happens to be Guobin's father. Yixin and Hu Guobin were classmates at design school and share a love-hate relationship. She Weixiang and his partner Victor run a dinner dress rental and auction business. Although from a wealthy background, he is estranged from his father and detests him for having a mistress. By chance, Yixin bumps into them and her fashion expertise comes into handy. A love triangle inevitably forms.

title: F-Rank Awakening: Zero to Superhero
description: Everyone writes Jake Miller off as an F-rank loser. Yet the day his powers awaken, the surge of energy erupts from him shakes the universe itself. With three months to save his mom, Jake enters the Superhero Trials to find a healer. His old bully is counting on him to make a fool of himself in front of thousands of people. If that power erupts again in the arena, who'll still be laughing?

title: The CEO's Hidden Heir
description: A stolen night. A hidden pregnancy. A son who carries the key to a billionaire's past. When Dr. Presley Raven returns to the city seeking a cure for her child's illness, she collides with the one man she never wanted to see again—CEOv, who now holds all the power. But this time, she's not running. She's fighting for her family, and she'll burn his world down if she has to.

title: Eternal Brotherhood S1-S2
description: Follows the heir of the Zichuan family. Together with his sworn brothers Di Lin and Si Te Lin, they set out to protect his family against threats.

title: Love Beyond Memory
description: To escape her stepfather’s clutches, Iris Moon returned to the city where she grew up after graduating college. There, she founded a housekeeping firm, but because of poor management, she could not afford rent.One day, a man came to her, offering her a fortune to work as a live-in nanny for him. It was only upon getting into the car that she realized her future boss was none other than Cedric Klein, the man known all over the city for being abusive.

title: Against the sky Supreme [English]
description: The entire universe is divided into the inner universe and the outer universe. The two universes are enemies of each other. The outer universe is ruled by demons, and the inner universe is divided into The Realm of gods, the Eternal Realm, and the Mortal Realm. In the universe, there are countless mortal worlds like the Tianfa Continent, and they are collectively referred to as the Jiutian Xin Region. In the field of Jiutian Xin, nine immortal emperors commanded all star fields in nine layers. Above the nine heavens is the realm of purification of immortal gods.

title: Two Wheel Cowboy
description: This feature documentary follows director Daniel C. Doran as he rides his bicycle from Ithaca, New York to Los Angeles, California.

title: Born to Rule, Not to Obey
description: When Ava Sinclair invites her classmates to her home for a birthday celebration, her nemesis, Zoe Harrington, shows up uninvited. Looking around the luxurious estate of Ava's family, arrogance fills Zoe's heart as she criticizes Ava's family photo to satisfy her desire to retaliate against Ava. Upon calling Ava's mother a mistress, she calls Ava and her CEO brother, Owen Sinclair, illegitimate children, humiliating the identities of Ava's entire family.

title: [Dubbed] Immortality Farm
description: For generations, House Hale has guarded a secret no one dares reveal. When little Mia is adopted into the family, her hidden talent shakes the sects and draws fierce rivals, greedy elders, and royal eyes. As the children rise through the trials, one question remains: what power is the Hale family really protecting?

title: After I Went Blind, I Slept With My Husband's Uncle
description: Ballerina Daisy loses her sight. When her vision returns, she discovers the man in her bed is her husband's uncle, Thorne. Her husband swapped her to carry on an affair. Daisy feigns blindness, plots revenge, and finds love with Thorne.

title: Itlu Amma
description: On a stormy night, a young boy named Venu gets stabbed. The police are of no help, so his mother, Balasaraswathi, sets out to look for him all by herself.

title: My Calorie Boy
description: Kang Jiawei and Xu Jingjing, along with their group of high school friends, navigate friendship, growth, and self-discovery, experiencing the highs and lows of their unique youth.
